title: MEIKO — Card Story

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, everyone, how's the show so far?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, I hope you'll enjoy the rest of the show too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As for now, I will sing my next song!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, look at that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Is that TV over there playing the video you were showing me the other day?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
They may be showing MEIKO's live performance.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, that felt pretty good!
Let's keep this momentum going for the next song too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: MEIKO is so cool.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Her red outfit is really nice, too.
Feels like something a truly mature woman would wear.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes. I've never worn leather clothing like that before...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, I have one or two, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's not easy to pull off that sort of look successfully.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You guys still want more, right?!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Her singing really draws you in...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm... Maybe we'll become like that too in another ten years?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? I think you could definitely become like that, but not me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Why not? You never know, right?
Maybe you'll be even more like her than me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You think so?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I think I would really rather have an older sister like her instead of becoming like that myself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You would?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm, that's true. A cool-looking and dependable older sister would rock! Someone who comes wake me up every morning...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, wake you up?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! With a calm and gentle voice like...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, sunshine, it's already morning. Wakey-wakey.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'll wash up, and she already have breakfast ready for me at the living room!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And then she says, Make sure to eat your lunch, and have a good day out there. Man, that'd be such a great start to my day...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm surprised you like to be coddled like that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh? N-Not really.
I was just thinking if it was MEIKO, she'd totally do something like that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, she seems so reliable and patient, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And, well, my mom isn't very good at cooking...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Dad leaves early to get ready for the shop. I just think it'd be nice to have someone make a nice meal for me.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: S-Stop laughing at me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Come on, everyone, let's sing together! Clap your hands!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's bring this house down!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Phew...
The committee meeting went a bit over time today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, we had a lot of things to discuss and decide on... Ah.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The signal just turned red.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. But it's not like I have anything on later, so...
Hey, look at that!

Oh, you're right.
They may be showing MEIKO's live performance.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everyone's looking at that large TV there.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, that's a video of the VIRTUAL SINGER event, isn't it?
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: My classmates were talking about it too because the video will only be available for a limited time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminds me... Shii may have been watching a video of Megurine Luka the other day too...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It's probably from the same event. They've been putting up digest videos of each of the VIRTUAL SINGERS who were a part of the event.
I think I would really rather have an older sister like her instead of becoming like that myself.
Hm, that's true. A cool-looking and dependable older sister would rock! Someone who comes wake me up every morning...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A dependable older sister...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: MEIKO is the one singing right now, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's so elegant and cool... How wonderful.
Hehe. I'm surprised you like to be coddled like that.

Huh? N-Not really.
I was just thinking if it was MEIKO, she'd totally do something like that...
I mean, she seems so reliable and patient, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright! I think I'm ready to start the next song.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you guys ready too?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good! That's what I wanted to hear!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let the next song begin!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: MEIKO is really so cool.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
She has such a beautiful form when she sings.
It's like she has no doubts at all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And even though she's a VIRTUAL SINGER, I can feel so much confidence in her every move.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If I was more like that, maybe Shii would allow herself to depend on me more?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm...not sure about that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Do you want her to depend on you?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course I do! Then I would be able to hug her tightly whenever I wanted...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sigh... Is there any way for me to become MEIKO for a day, like one of those boss-for-a-day shows?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If that makes me more like a dependable older sister, then Shii will definitely...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Uh... I really don't think...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. It doesn't just have to be Shii.
Feel free to depend on me as well, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Older sister, huh...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everyone, thank you for making so much noise for me! You're the reason why I sang so well!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Enjoy the rest of the show!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hi.
Is Len around?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hello, Akito, Toya.
Len hasn't shown up, yet.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You wanted to talk to him?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: He said he'd DJ for us here today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: In that case he should be here any moment. Take a seat and I'll make you coffee.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you, MEIKO.
Akito, let's sit by the window.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Again?
That must be your favorite table.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It gives me the best view of the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
So that's why. I like the ambiance, too.
Reminds me of Weekend Garage.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's probably because you guys share an attachment to that place.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here's your coffee.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Did you notice the RAD WEEKEND flyer outside?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I didn't until now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's there as a reminder of your wish to surpass it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our feelings and ambitions manifest in a variety of ways throughout this world, I suppose.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It feels so eerie, though, that a weird place like this exists, and that we can just chill here sipping coffee.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You think it's weird?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, if this isn't weird then I don't know what is.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Like, where even are we, exactly?
How come we get teleported here by playing a song on a phone?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's a world created by our feelings, so the song which encompasses them is our link to it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I know that, but that's not the point.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Well, I don't know any more about it than you do...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I just accept that it is what it is.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You just accept it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It's not that I haven't wondered about it too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really? Because despite always looking so serious and diligent, you've got that weird tendency to totally ignore anything that might be a pain...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
How to explain it...
To me, the inner workings of this world don't really matter.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's a SEKAI created from our feelings.
I like it here. And to me, that's enough.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, but it keeps bugging the heck out of me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sorry to interrupt your lively chat.
More coffee?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yes, please.
Toya, aren't you into crime novels?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Isn't part of the fun of reading those trying to figure out who's got an alibi, what the murder weapon was, and the like? So why aren't you curious about this world?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: In those stories, there's usually some crafty trick involved, but I don't think that's the case here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How can you be so sure?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Are you laughing at us?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course! You two are just like Rin and Len!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't know if that's something to be proud about or insulted by...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't see anything wrong with it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sometimes Rin and Len have wild fights, but they respect each other despite that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Each insists it's them that's right, so it's hard work getting them to apologize and make up...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I think they're only able to argue their points so passionately because they trust each.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suppose trust plays into this.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But it takes more than trust to be able to defend your opinion even if you know it will upset your friend.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You think so?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Fighting with your friends doesn't feel good.
It hurts to feel misunderstood by them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's why I think the setting matters, too. It needs to be somewhere you feel comfortable and safe, otherwise the stress of the situation would be too much.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A place like this cafe, or like Weekend Garage, gives you the reassurance you need for that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks, Toya.
I am happy to hear that as the owner of this cafe.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, true.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Maybe it's not just this cafe, but this entire place that offers a safe and accepting environment to us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't see why not! SEKAI exists for you to be yourselves and breathe easy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So take advantage of that and keep dropping in for my coffee!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You brought me cookies?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That's right. It's to say thank you for all you've been doing for us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thanks. They smell delicious.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I knew you could brew amazing tea and coffee at your dad's cafe, but I had no idea you could bake, too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I thought cookies would be a nice freebie to serve along with the hot drinks, so I learned to make them!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, that's amazing dedication!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know they're actually super easy to make? You can definitely make them too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I wouldn't be so sure...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't we share them?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They'll taste even better with some black tea. Wait a couple minutes and I'll make some.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And here's the tea, as promised.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, thank you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Nice!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mmm, you make excellent tea, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it makes me feel calm and happy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, then I did a good job!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: My dad serves tea very quickly, but I like how you take your time making it just right.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You warm up the teacups, and check the water temperature before pouring it over the leaves...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You rarely see anyone take so much care to bring out the full flavor of the tea leaves.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's nice to feel appreciated!
I've been doing it this way for so long, it's now second nature to me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
You master a skill and then it becomes sort of like muscle memory.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You make it sound so easy, but I couldn't do any of that, so it's very impressive to me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You've got impressive skills of your own, like photography. I wouldn't know what to do with a fancy camera.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
My pictures aren't that good...
I'm just an amateur.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You make your customers happy, but I take photos just for myself.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Does it really matter?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It does. Also, you're great at sports, and you do fine at school in general...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But, Kohane, didn't you recently discover another great skill you have?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Did I?
What do you mean?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, of course!
You're great at singing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We sang together in front of so many people, and they all loved it!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Right, I forgot about that!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: See? You've got lots to be proud of too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Well, maybe not lots, but at least something.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We all have our talents, and I'm sure we'll keep discovering more and more.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! I'm sure you've got bucketloads of potential lying dormant within you, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, stop it, you two.
But thanks, hehe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You know, you can acquire a brand new skill right away. I'll teach you how to bake cookies!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: In return, you help me study for exams... How about that, eh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Of course, I don't mind helping you at all!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. The sky will be the limit if you two work together.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Humhum♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You look like you're having fun, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, hello, Miku.
Welcome to the cafe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't remember asking for any help today, so are you here as a customer?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right. But you're in the midst of something, right? Anything I can do to help?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You want to help?
That'd be great.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So... What're you doing, anyway?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sorting out the coffee beans while there's still no one in the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There will always be a few beans that are not in the best of conditions when you buy them from a shop.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Keeping these damaged beans will affect the taste of the coffee that you brew.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, you really know a lot.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It was written on the label of the bag of beans I bought. Wasn't it nice of them to warn us?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, you just read what was on the label...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How do you pick out the damaged beans, though?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You spread the beans out like this and split them up into usable and unusable beans.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But there are so many beans!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's not as hard as it looks. For example, see this whitish bean here? That's not usable. Easy to spot, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're right. The color's completely different.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: See? And then there's the opposite—overly dark beans.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's not usable too... It's really quite easy to tell if you look closely enough.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. So, can you help me with this?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's see... Can you pick out the white beans and beans that are of a different size than usual?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I can do that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you.
Let's make delicious coffee together!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mhm?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This is really boring work, huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, you could say that again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But there's a big difference between the coffee brewed from before and after doing this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is it really that big?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. And don't you want these unroasted beans to become a delicious pot of coffee? Especially since it would only take a little effort on your part?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I would rather have something more delicious than not if I can help it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You too?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I also make coffee for myself, you know.
Not just for customers.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I use my own personal special blend.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, that's not fair.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehehe, that's the perk of being a cafe owner, right? At least let me have that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well... As long as the coffee you serve to customers always tastes good, I guess that's fine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're so sweet. I'll treat you to my special blend later, to thank you for helping out!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sigh...
I can't get over how good MEIKO's coffee is...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She puts in a lot of time and effort is why.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, that's true.
She's always so careful when brewing the coffee...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you so much, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's not that hard.
I'm just happy to hear that everyone's enjoying the brew.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
By the way, I just wanted to know.
When you think of sandwiches, what filling immediately comes to mind?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hm? Well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Sandwich filling?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why do you want to know, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe, sorry for the abrupt shift.
I was actually thinking of adding more items to the cafe menu, you see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And sandwiches are the first on my list, so I wanted to know what everyone thinks is the best choice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How about egg sandwiches? There's no need for much preparation so you can serve them quickly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you don't have to take that into consideration. As you can see, we have a lot of free time in this cafe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In that case, I think BLT sandwiches might be nice. Bacon, lettuce, tomatoes, and...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, BLT's usually the first one most people would think of. I don't really like it myself, though.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I remember now. You don't like tomatoes, right?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ugh... S-Something like that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
A sandwich with no tomatoes...
Maybe a fruit sandwich?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Right, there's that too. But since this'll be the first new addition, maybe something more mainstream like cutlet sandwiches will be better received?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I didn't even know there were so many different types. You two sure know your sandwiches.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
D-Do we?
I was just suggesting sandwiches that I personally liked, that's all...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Besides, sandwiches are easy to make because you can just put your favorite foods in between!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, okay.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh no! Kohane, we need to go now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Huh? Oh...you're right!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You have a performance?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup! We're gonna go sing our hearts out!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you for the coffee, MEIKO.
Let's talk again at another time, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah. I'll be waiting for you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thanks for your suggestions too.
I'll take them all into consideration.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Can't wait to see the new menu!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's nice to know they're so excited to perform.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, what made you want to add more items to the menu anyway?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, the four of them found their true feelings, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Of wanting to hold the ultimate event, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. And from now on, they'll be striving to make those feelings become reality.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But it won't be easy for them to reach their dream. There will be a lot of obstacles along the way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want this SEKAI to be a place where they can feel warmly welcomed. If they ever feel down, we'll fill their tummies up and give them strength to try harder again!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's what made me come up with the idea.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see. Sounds like something you'd come up with indeed.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You think so?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll help you with that new sandwich menu.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Really? That'll be great. Thank you, Miku!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What to use for today's special blend...? Ah, let's go with this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And then I need to... Oh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hello, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um... Is this a bad time?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: An, Kohane, welcome!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sorry, but I'm not quite ready to open yet.
Please, take a seat. It won't be too long.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, actually... We're not here as customers today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: You've already done so much for us, MEIKO, so we've been trying to come up with some way to pay you back.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So would it be okay if we helped out with the cafe?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We really want to help as long as you're okay with it and don't think we'll be too much of a bother.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, so that's why you came so early! Okay. In that case, you could help me get ready to open.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, of course! Thank you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No problem, MEIKO!
Just tell us what needs to be done.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The tables need to be wiped, the floor mopped... Oh, and we also need to get the cups and saucers ready...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The cups and saucers?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
I change them out from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I see! I didn't know!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Looks like that caught your interest, so I'll do the tables and floors then, okay?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? Thanks, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No problem. MEIKO, can I borrow that cleaning cloth?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Be my guest.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Excuse me, MEIKO.
Which cups and saucers should I get out?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Pick any design you like, Kohane. There are six of each, and make sure to give them a wipe with a clean cloth.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay! Hmm... Oh, wow.
These antique ones are so cool!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, so now I just need to wipe them...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: MEIKO, like this?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, just like that. You're doing great.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
MEIKO, I'm done wiping the tables.
Where can I find a mop for the floor?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, it's at the back, over there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Got it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Hehe. Their differences in personality really show through here.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(Kohane's very careful and precise.
An's independent and full of initiative.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (It also makes a big difference that An's used to working at a cafe like this.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Phew... I finally finished cleaning one set.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. There's no rush, so you can go at your own pace.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks, but seeing the way An works makes me want to do better too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Because I'm her partner.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I owe her for getting me into singing and encouraging me to be braver.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She has this dream that she's chasing relentlessly, to surpass RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She's amazing in so many ways that I'm not.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But at the very least, I want her to be proud that I'm her partner.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You like her a lot, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Amazing in ways that she isn't, huh...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you and good job!
It was a breeze with your help!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've earned yourself a little treat. Here's a cup of today's special blend coffee for each of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, really? Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're very welcome!
Please, sit down and relax.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane. When I went to get the mop, I overheard you telling MEIKO that you like me a lot?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you heard that...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. I love you too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Wah...!
Hey, that tickles...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Right now Kohane's learning a lot from An...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But one day An may find out that Kohane has her own unique strengths that she can draw from...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (These two, together with Akito and Toya, are shaping up to be a team with a huge amount of potential...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can't take my eyes off of you guys at all...
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku! Come on in.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hi. Am I your only customer?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: For now, but I think Kohane and her friends are coming soon.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They've been practicing quite a bit for their next event, recently. They really want to give it everything they have.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I got a little worried too when Kohane looked so glum the other day...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But it seems like Kohane and An got things sorted out.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, you already know about this?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Kind of...
I knew she came here for advice.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I guessed from her expression that something was on her mind.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, then you could have talked to her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, you two were already in the middle of a discussion and I didn't want to interrupt.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Besides, Kohane managed to find her own way to deal with her problems before.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Plus, An's a determined and resourceful girl.
I was sure she'd be fine without me too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And they had you to lean on if they really needed anything.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It turned out just as you expected then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I listened to their troubles, but I didn't tell them exactly what to do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They solved their problem by facing it together without my help.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's great!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I was surprised that Kohane and An would sort of fall out like that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They do get along very well, but don't forget that they haven't known each other for very long.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They're still in the process of finding out what each other's like and learning to understand one another.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think that this little stumble was a necessary step on their way to becoming closer friends.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're right. They struck me as such an amazing team, so I assumed that they'd always be in tune...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But they may still run into some rough patches...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and they may end up hurting each other's feelings...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Even when you're friends with someone, you may sometimes offend them without meaning to or be disappointed by something they did...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you don't seem particularly worried?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm not. Those are just some possibilities. I enjoy sitting back and watching how the future unfolds.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Besides, they've discovered the joy of singing together as Vivid BAD SQUAD.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Whatever happens, I don't think they'll be willing to give that up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Another reason they won't let minor hiccups like that get in their way is that they have this goal of surpassing the legendary RAD WEEKEND.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. They've already discovered their true feelings too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Their SEKAI song will keep reminding them of their shared vision.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm excited to see just how much they manage to achieve.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I believe that they will fulfill their dream.
I want to see them do it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I do too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, and they've just arrived in SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'll go out and say hi.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay. Have fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll brew up some special tea and coffee for when they get here.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Miku, Len, do you have a moment?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have something important to tell you before we begin rehearsing for our Christmas show.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sure. What's up?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Our troupe is about to get a new member.

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: Whaaat?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
She's very excited to join us,
so let's not keep her waiting.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hello, Miku and Len! I'm new to this, but I don't really need a special introduction or anything, do I?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay! You're super welcome!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha. Thank you for the warm welcome♪
I'm happy to be joining you!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah! You came at the perfect time too!
We're just getting ready for our Christmas show!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Would you like to do it with us, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Of course! That's what I'm here for!
I'll be happy to help in any way I can♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. With that much enthusiasm, we'll have plenty for you to do! Let's get started!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, someone needs to go get the plushies too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right! I'll go and get them!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thanks, Len! Okay, I'm ready to roll up my sleeves and get down to it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright. While we wait for the others, we could start thinking about how to decorate the stage.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
We haven't decided anything yet,
so any suggestions are welcome.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... What would make it Christmas-y...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, of course! Hey, KAITO!
Are there any fir trees in this SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hmm... I can't tell you off the top of my head, but I'll check. What do you need them for?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, this place has singing flowers, so I thought there might also be singing trees!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And of course, fir trees are a central part of Christmas. I'm sure everyone would love to see a real Christmas tree!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe, okay. I can picture everyone being overwhelmed by delight.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, here's another idea... We can pile a bunch of presents up high to make a Christmas tree too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Imagine how impressive it'd be if we made it like 100-meters tall!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What?! 100 meters?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, as the play reaches its climax, we can have plushies jump out of the presents! Pop, pop, pop! One by one♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What do you think? Wouldn't that be fun?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha! It'll be a lot of work, but yes, it sounds fantastic!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, and Christmas lights!
We'll need those too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why don't we put up colorful lights all over this SEKAI? And on our costumes too! We'd literally be dazzling then!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's also an excellent idea!
Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? What's so funny?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I just can't believe you only just got here and you're already coming up with so many terrific suggestions.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Really? I'm just saying whatever I think is fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Does any of it actually seem doable?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Well, I'm not sure about finding a singing tree, but we can go ahead with the present tower and Christmas lights.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I think they'll be great fun, but we'll need more hands to get everything done in time. Hopefully, the plushies can help us out too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But aren't they all really small?
Won't it be too much work for them?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
They've helped us out quite a bit already.
They're more capable than you might think.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. Just as I joined this troupe, they were saying that they want to help with stage lighting, other roles and whatnot so...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I guess they'd feel left out if they weren't allowed to just because of their size.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You think of everything, KAITO! No, wait. Mr. Troupe Leader!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, I'm baaack! I brought the plushies!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Welcome back! But we're still waiting for Miku...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How about we start setting up the stage while we wait for her? I suggested a few things to KAITO while you were away too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But they might end up being a lot of work, so I'd like to hear your opinions on whether or not we should go with them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Sure. I'm game!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thanks, Len! First...!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright. I think we're done tidying up.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. And since we have no shows tomorrow, we can all take it easy for now... Hm?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: MEIKO and KAITO! Hellooo!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hey, Emu! Wait for us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, it's you guys! Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We came by to let you know we've wrapped up our Christmas show and everything went as planned!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's great! Congratulations, guys!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. You all have this look on your faces too.
I'm guessing you did well in the contest?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We did! We have some work left to beat our rivals, but we plan on winning it all with our next show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wow! That sounds really exciting!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But do you know what's even more exciting♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... What could that be?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe! Talking to you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We were so busy with the Christmas show, we only got to exchange greetings and never had a chance to actually talk to you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Aww, you guys are sooo sweet!
I was hoping we'd get a chance to talk too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Well, your timing couldn't be better.
We're done with shows for the day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right! In that case...
How did you guys all spend Christmas?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Christmas Day...?
I was with my family.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: This year it was all of us together, including my sister, so it was more fun than usual!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, so you have a sister?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yeah. She also got to spend Christmas Eve with her friends at a Christmas party like she's always wanted.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They exchanged presents and she has the ones she received decorating her room now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(Hehe, he's so happy for his sister!
He must care about her quite a bit...!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And you, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Huh, m-me? Um, I...
I had cake with my family.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: After that, I stayed in my room to watch the stream for an online gaming tournament.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I also spent Christmas cooped up in my room.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The electronic components I asked Santa to bring me came right on time and I stayed up until morning assembling them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, what? Electronic components from Santa...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He just means he ordered them online, dummy.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's not untrue.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Christmas is just another day to you, isn't it, Rui?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
My turn! My turn!
I had a cake party with the mascots!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: With the mascots?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The mascots that sometimes help with our shows at the Phoenix Wonderland's Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In other words, you spent Christmas with friends!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks for telling us! It's interesting how each of you enjoyed Christmas in a different way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And did Santa come and visit you all?
Did you find gifts when you woke up?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I used to find presents by my pillow when I was little, but my parents just give them to me directly now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's the same for me.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Really? I always find them outside my door.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: To your room? That's interesting.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Apparently, I move a lot in my sleep, so they might get knocked over if they're left next to my pillow or something.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I see.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: My grandpa used to dress up as Santa to bring me presents!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He's gone now...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But I still get presents.
The mascots bring me them in secret!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: They don't know that I figured out it's them, so please don't tell them! It's so much fun every year♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Aww, that's so nice of them.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, our mascots are the best☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Your turn, MEIKO!
How did you spend Christmas?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I was with all my friends here in SEKAI. The plushies joined us too and we decided to have a parade!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha, right! MEIKO came up with that idea and the plushies were suddenly all for it, so it turned into a big extravaganza.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow, a parade! That's so awesome!
I wish I could've been there!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Maybe we'll do it again next year.
If we do, you'll all be invited!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: YEEEAH! Did you hear that, Tsukasa?! Christmas with MEIKO! And we're gonna have a parade!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm not deaf, Emu. Calm down! Isn't it too early to be planning for next year's Christmas? I mean, we just had...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
But that does pique my interest.
SEKAI parades must be an extraordinary sight.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'd love to see one too. It must be so cute with all the plushies marching together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Then I'll pencil in us in to celebrate Christmas together next year!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Let's start with something simple.
Honami, can you count us in.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Here we go!
One, two, three, four!
song00003_off_f

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(Good! They're all in sync.
Their sound is getting much better too.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Let's split up for individual practice now.
Would you be okay with that, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure, of course.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! Time to work on that part that was bugging me...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(Instruments really are wonderful things.
It's a real delight to hear them play together.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But it's also fun to listen to each of them individually as they practice on their own.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, MEIKO? Do you have a minute?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How can I help, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I can't seem to figure out a drumming technique I like...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Really?
You sounded perfectly fine to me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um, do you remember that time when you played with Miku and Luka?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That was when I realized how much of an effect the drummer has on a performance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not only did you maintain a good tempo, you carried Miku and Luka through the entire way.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And I never once saw you hesitate.
You were so cool and collected...
And I was wondering how I could be like you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Aww, you're making me blush.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But the part about not hesitating isn't true at all.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That may be because I try to resolve any worries I have during practice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, I have faith that Miku or Luka will be there for me if I do make any mistakes during a performance.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And I feel comfortable going all out as a result.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Aren't the drums supposed to be the band's foundation? Is it okay for me to be leaning on other people...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hahaha! You can't build a house with just the foundation, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh! Um... Yes, I see your point.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yup. Anyway, why don't you play something for me? I may be able to give you better advice after that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Really? Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright, here it goes!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(Luka was right. She's solid...
I might be the more envious one here...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Hmm. Okay, I get it now.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: H-How was I...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You not being able to figure out a good drumming technique is probably not something you can resolve on your own.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? Wh-What does that mean?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your band is still quite new, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You might be feeling lost about how to perform because your band as a whole hasn't worked that out yet.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So it's probably difficult to find the right technique to focus on or judge just how much free reign you have.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: To add to our foundation analogy, you'll need to decide what sort of house you want to build, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, that's true.
That makes so much sense!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: See?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The kind of house we all want to build... So we should decide on what sort of performances we want to put on?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's one way. On the other hand, you could learn to become fully independent!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You know, to become THE pillar that props up your band?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes... I mean, if I can...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. Don't worry. Everyone has a different take when it comes to this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Maybe I was feeling lost because our band is so new and none of us know what we want to actually do yet...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I think that also means there are a lot of other things we can learn in the meantime.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I think so too. The hesitation you're talking about really might not be a bad thing either, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you! I'll try not to worry about it so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, I'm glad that's sorted out.
Good luck, Honami.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much for lending me your ear, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO

rows.Line: Yes. I'd expect nothing less from her.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree. We can learn a lot from her in terms of how to interact with the crowd!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, it's time for us to have some fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That was great, MEIKO! You were awesome!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you, Miku!
Did you guys have fun?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We did! That sense of togetherness we felt was really incredible too♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! It's like the crowd was a part of making your show happen!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Really? That's something I've been working on, so I'm glad that you're saying this♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You have?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know that singing and dancing well are important, but I think the most important thing to keep in mind is whether or not the crowd is having fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why I'm trying to keep an eye on how they're doing even if I'm in the middle of a song.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that's why you were calling out to them so much!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. You could tell too since everybody was singing and waving their glow sticks together in unison!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's just what I do♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. Wasn't there something you wanted to talk to me about once my show was over?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We should have plenty of time now since everything's finished.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's about how I've been meaning to introduce you to Minori and the others.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Today, we came to invite you to do just that♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Minori and the others...?
You mean the ones who created this SEKAI...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah♪
They're called MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They're idols that make videos and do streams online. They even just did their very first show the other day!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Their first show?! That's fantastic!
So they're doing pretty well then...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They said that they'll do their best as freelance idols...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it sounded so difficult to make it as an idol in their world...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's why I want to be able to help them out as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You being there for them would help encourage them even more, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So MEIKO, please!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're such good girls too. I'm sure you'll immediately start liking them♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Now I'm the one that's getting all excited to meet them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course I'll meet them!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you so much, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't worry about it. It's our job to help them as much as we can, right♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So what do I need to do to actually meet them?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then come to the stage that Rin and I usually use...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We've been practicing with them there lately, so I'm sure you'll be able to meet them!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay. I'll make sure to check it out!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We'll be waiting for you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll be there! Hehe. I can't wait to meet them!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good morning, everyone♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO!
Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's been a little while. How have you been?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Good, thanks!
Miku told me that you'd be practicing here today, so I decided to come and see♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, does that mean you'll help us practice?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'd love to!
If you don't mind that is...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes, please do!
It's okay, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course! Thanks for coming, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'd love to learn as much as I can from you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, me too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If that's the case, thank you for having me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So what are you working on today?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We've been working on dance formation for our routine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that sounds like fun!
Shall we get started then?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One, two, three, four...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori, you're leaning too much! It looks like you're about to fall over!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Okay! Can we try that again?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Oh, this is good. Airi can say what needs to be said and Minori takes it seriously...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Now, let's see how Haruka and Shizuku are doing...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (The last time I met them, Shizuku seemed so worried about Haruka...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So just before the chorus, what if we have our elbows bent instead of being straight and transition from there?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I have a feeling that it'll better match this song's lyrics and warm tone...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah. I like your idea.
Let's check with Airi and Minori to see what they think.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Hehe. They seem just fine now.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... It's coming together pretty well now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it is. But it's also important not to work too hard, so why not take a break?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. A water break might not be bad.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That was a pretty hard workout.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, break it is!
But try to stay warm...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks for your help, MEIKO.
Here's a towel if you need one.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you, Haruka!
That'd be nice. I'll take it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Also, MEIKO...
I really appreciate how you've been paying us so much attention.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Weren't you just watching Shizuku and I work on our dance routine just now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I thought that I should thank you for doing that and going out of your way to talk about these things with us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, is that all?
It's okay. Don't worry about that♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But you really do have a good eye, don't you, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think it's because I've been performing in groups for so long. At the same time, I know that just being observant is enough.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I thought for the longest time that I was doing just fine, but I was actually making everyone else worry.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even when I was told that taking breaks is important, I didn't really know what to do with that information.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But you're speaking in past tense, so does that mean you're alright now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Shizuku helped me understand what was going on.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see...
I'm glad you have such good friends!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
More than that even...
I'm not sure what I'd do without them now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So I'll make sure to do everything I can so that I don't cause them any concern.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Good for you.
But if you'll allow me to add just one little thing...♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Things like that don't happen overnight. It may take some time to get used to.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's like how it'd be unreasonable to ask someone who's naturally right-handed to start doing everything with their left hand, you know?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe it's important to give yourself the time you need to get used to everything...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome♪
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you for lending me so much of your time talking with me like this, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Come back anytime.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm glad she was able to figure out what her next step needs to be.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But it still won't solve her problem.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She has An, Akito and Toya, so I think she'll be fine but...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Heya!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We're here...!
Hm? What?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Is it just you here, MEIKO?
Where's everyone else?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You mean Kohane and the others?
They just left a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Nooo! We just sensed that they were here and came running over!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I was looking forward to talking and doing stuff with them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sorry, you two.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But our little chat sort of turned into me giving Kohane and An advice about something, so I'm not sure they would've been in the mood to play...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hm? It was just Kohane and An here?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that's right.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What were you giving them advice about, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... I probably shouldn't tell you behind their backs...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Details aside, they were concerned about having confidence in themselves.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Having confidence in themselves?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. Kohane in particular seems to have never experienced that feeling of pride or confidence...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What?! Not even once?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So what happened after they told you? Did they figure out what to do?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, not quite. I just gave them some words to think on.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But that's it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
I mean, how someone feels confident about themselves varies wildly from person to person.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I'm sure An, Akito and Toya will help figure out the rest.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And look at you two. Could it be that you wanted to talk to them about this too?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that and...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's just... That's sort of all we're able to do for them, you know?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I know, right...?
We're always trying so hard to help make their dreams come true.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? What if I told you that just listening to what someone has to say can make them feel much better?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's true, but we still end up wanting to do something for them...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You and Miku are adults, so it's easy for you to watch over everyone. But for us, it's really hard.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you sure? I feel like you've done quite a bit for them already...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Don't forget that these are also just my own personal beliefs, so you don't need to feel compelled to do exactly what I do. Understand?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe in what I believe in. You two believe in what you believe in. That's completely normal, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why it's also natural for you two to act and think differently.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So it's okay for us to try and help them more?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, of course.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (For them to make their dream come true, I'm sure they'll have to face many different challenges along the way.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (We need to be there for them and support them in whatever ways we can.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, however... You can't be pushy about it, okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You have to always keep their feelings in mind. Be listeners and not speakers...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Promise me you'll do that.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: We promise!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And since you're here, would you like something to drink...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm parched since we literally ran over here! I'd like an orange juice!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, coming right up.
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So they managed to get revenge on that event they mentioned? What was it called, STAY GOLDEN?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it seems that way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Good for them. Especially since they spent so much time practicing here too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure you felt a sense of relief as well, Miku. You seemed so anxious as the event approached.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That was because I know that practicing as much as possible doesn't necessarily mean you'll get results when it matters.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm so proud of them. Kohane in particular since I heard she did something absolutely incredible.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, really?!
I wish I could've heard her sing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of which...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're here early. Are you done with practice already?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yup. We're gonna be in another battle event tomorrow as a team, so we took it easy today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, really...?
Do you think you'll win?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, yeah.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We couldn't be in better shape either.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's great, and I wouldn't expect anything less.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Now then, what can I get you guys?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Here you are, Kohane, An.
That should be everything, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I kinda feel bad about us coming in all together and barraging you with orders.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm doing this because I love it, so there's nothing for you to worry about.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But it never ceases to amaze me how lively this place has become...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, I was saving that cookie for later...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I didn't see your name on it!
The early bird gets the worm, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How is it that you two can fight over absolutely nothing?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line:
Because he...!
Because she...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, Weekend Garage?
It would be nice to try their coffee sometime.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then why don't I bring you some of their original blend next time? All I'd have to do is buy some.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You'd do that?! Thank you, I can't wait to try it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's such a strange thing. Rin, Len and everyone else hardly ever used to come here. Now it's like they're here every day.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, come to think of it, I didn't really see Rin around when we first came here...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. That may also have something to do with her constantly fighting with Len...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But she seemed to be wandering and singing all by herself for some time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I never knew that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, she and Len eventually made up. Then they met all of you, started singing together, and found a home here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that they saw you guys and felt a need to treat each other better as partners.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You may have to ask them to find out if I'm right, but I believe so.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for being such a good influence.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, is something bothering you?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It just surprised me a little is all.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. It just felt like we've been relying on you, MEIKO, and everybody else here so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That's a two-way street.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've already done quite a lot for all of us here.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We have...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You care about your partners and your team. You work diligently as a team to overcome whatever challenges you're faced with...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku, Rin, Len, everyone... They all saw how you worked together as a team and are doing their best to keep up with you guys.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And I couldn't be happier to see them practicing so hard.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, with the exception of KAITO. You know how he is...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I'm also here to make my cafe a place where you can all feel like you belong.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yes, I see.
It really is nice being here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I think so too.
You're even here to give us great advice about stuff.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And feel free to keep asking.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Plus, you coming to visit helps make this place just that much more vibrant.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Such a vibrant little cafe.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Hehe. I wonder if our little friend will return too now that this place has become so lively.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to when that happens.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... What should I do for my next show?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Being able to bond with the audience during shows up to this point has been nice, but I kind of want to make this one a little more special...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Aren't there any good ideas out there...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah, I can do something moon viewing themed!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It'll definitely feel special too since it's going to be so different from what I usually do♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But as much as I want to start working on this idea, I really don't know much about moon viewings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Maybe I should ask Minori and the girls about this.
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Classroom

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There. Our moon viewing stream should be all set to go now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Your ideas were so well-thought-out too, Shizuku. This is sure to become a fun stream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, Shizuku, you did an amazing job!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you♪
I wouldn't have been able to do this without all your help.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hi, girls, do you have a minute?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-MEIKO?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. Sorry for the surprise visit. There's something I'd like to ask all of you.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ask us? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Well...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <So I was wondering if you girls could teach me what you know about moon viewings...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. If that's the case, we'd be happy to help!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Really?!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. We were just having a discussion about some moon viewing segments that we'll be doing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It could even act as a mock rehearsal for us, so why don't you sit back and watch us for a little bit?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, I'd love to! Thank you.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'll start with an introduction...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Great, thanks♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's believed that moon viewings first gained prominence in Japan during the Heian period.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<The Heian era...
That's around when the Pillow Book was written, yes?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, exactly. And moon viewing originally began as an event that was celebrated by nobles.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: These exclusive parties mostly involved drinking sake, reading poems and playing wind or string instruments while riding on special boats.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It started gaining popularity amongst commoners during the Edo period.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But by this time, it'd turned into a traditional farming ritual.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, I see. So the actual purpose of the event evolved as time passed.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! What began as a series of events for celebrating the fall harvest became one really big party!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so interesting how this all came about.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And it kept evolving too. Now, we celebrate by presenting offerings in the form of dango and pampas grass.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: How we celebrate moon viewing today is actually a rather recent development.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <That's so intriguing! I've learned so much already!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, rabbits are closely tied with moon viewings because of how they were portrayed in folk tales...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I believe that's about everything...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Do you think it'll help?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes, I think so! Nobles, the harvest... I'm starting to get some good ideas already♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really?! That's great!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I'll try to work what I learned from you all today into my next show!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you so much♪>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Alright, how do I go about this show?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I could wear something much more Japanese and... Oh, I could even try working in some traditional Japanese dances into my dance routine♪)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, MEIKO, have you decided what you wanna do for your show?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. Well...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You'll just have to wait until then♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: No...! Can you give us a tiny clue...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'll make sure to let you know when it'll be, so I hope you'll be able to come by and see it♪>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Great! I absolutely promise to go!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be looking forward to it, MEIKO!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, my costume's all ready and so is everything else for this show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All that's left is for me to stay focused and keep practicing. Hehe. I'm so excited!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, hello!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku! Luka! Hi there♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You're doing a moon viewing show, right? I can't wait to see it♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: How's everything going for it? Do you need any help?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
