The chef and any food for that matter are all gone.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: My apologies. Pity, the “Very Amazing Octopus” would have made for a nice conversation piece too.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Oh, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: We may not be able to actually eat anything right now, but how about we speak a little more about “eating”?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I have tasted many things in my time, so I am certain that this will tickle your fancy♥

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
Oh, willing to listen are we?
Hehe. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Now then... For our appetizer, let us begin with a story from my childhood.

rows.Speaker: Little Banica
rows.Line: I'm done. I don't want any more.

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line: No, you must finish everything on your plate...

rows.Speaker: Little Banica
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
Eat it!!
Now, open your mouth!!

rows.Speaker: Little Banica
rows.Line: No! Please, Mother, stop...!!

rows.Speaker: Mother
rows.Line:
I have to suffer so much!
And yet, you...!! Why not you...?!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
I was never truly free as a child.
I was forced to eat and eat and eat...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: It all had to do with Gula Illness. Although, I was spared from it then...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Oh, have you ever heard of the Gula Illness?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: It is a disease that one catches from the glass inhabited by the Demon of Gluttony. It may in fact be more appropriate to call it a curse...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: This curse causes its sufferer to become overwhelmed by an insatiable “desire to eat”.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: They usually end up dying after they begin consuming objects that normal humans cannot digest, including rocks and scissors.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: In order to keep that “desire to eat” at bay, one's stomach must be in a constant state of being full.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: There is no time to enjoy how anything tastes. You are to devour and consume if you wish to live.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Mostly everyone in my manor succumbed to it, including my own mother...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe. Was that a little too strong of an appetizer?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Next, a palette cleanser. How does a story about my first love sound?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Despite how I look, I was once the daughter of a Duke of the Beelzenian Empire, and was even betrothed to the prince of a neighboring land.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: My blue-haired prince, Carlos...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: We spent time so much time visiting the city and discussing food. It was quite fun.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: However, our engagement would ultimately be for naught...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Even so, I could still enjoy “eating”.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I was free to choose whatever I wished to eat. Not just to live, but to enjoy the very ingredients these foods were made from...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: And I wished to have my fellow countrymen feel that same joy, be they nobles or commoners...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: When my engagement was dissolved, as well as after my father died, I immersed myself in food.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: For a time, I was able to fill the hole in my heart by filling my stomach with the most delicious foods imaginable...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe. That may very well be why that demon began whispering to me...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: (Why is it so hard to breathe...?)

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: (My body feels... So heavy...)

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: (The doctor said, “Your organs are having a negative reaction to overeating”....)

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: (So maybe it would be prudent to eat a little less...)

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
(Huh? What was that...?
This air feels strange...)
Without “food”, what would you have left...?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Huh?! Wh-Who's there...?!
“Demon” is what they call me in your tongue.

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: At this rate, Banica, in six-months time, you will be dead.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Would that be because of overeating...?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I have no issues with that. I have had the pleasure of traveling the world and enjoying nearly all of its culinary delights.

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: No, you do not even know half of what is truly considered “food”...

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
Are you not curious?
There is a whole world of new and astounding “foods” out there that you have yet to see...

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: Pledge yourself to me and I may even be able to release you from your current fate.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
A deal with the devil, is it...?
With the same demon that took the lives of everybody from my manor, including my mother...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
I refuse...
I have no desire to make a deal with the likes of you.

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: So be it. But allow me to leave a little parting gift...

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: This glass contains a part of my own self, but it also houses what you seek...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: What I seek...?

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: Drink from it and our contract will be finalized.

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: So I ask again, Banica Conchita...

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: Without “food”, what would you have left...?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: What did it mean...?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: A world of new “foods”...?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: (Is it even possible? Are there actually “foods” that are yet to grace my tongue...?)

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: (I have traveled far and wide. Even to lands currently waging wars. I ate everything I could in these places...)

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: No, there is one thing I missed...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
The legendary red pig, “Baemu”.
I could not find it despite searching the world over...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: That demon's gift. Could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: A deep red. Almost to the point of being black. Not only that, I smell a tinge of iron...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I-Is this the blood of the Baemu...?!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: No, if I drink this...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: (My love of “food”...)

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: (Indeed, without “food”, what would I have left...?)

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Ah, the nostalgia. A tasty tale, was it not...?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe. And I still have many more stories to tell.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: My next one will be about eating something so delicious that it brought tears to my eyes.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Now, shall we continue with our “meal”?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
Oh, where are my manners...?
Look at me, doing all of the talking.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe. But allow me to tell you all about this pair of twin servants, as well as a certain cook. I promise not to disappoint♥

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Let us begin with the twins, Arte and Pollo...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: The girl, Arte, had a habit of declaring war on anything she disliked, but was a very capable servant and cook.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: The boy, Pollo, was much simpler and struggled to learn courtly manners, but had a much milder personality compared to his sister.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: They had been by my side since I was born, but they curiously never really aged as time went on.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: They ate very well too. Almost as much as I did. Strange, is it not...?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: And I must not forget Josef the cook...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: It was quite delightful having all of us living in my manor together...
Banica's Room

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
A parasite-sausage dish...?
You added this to tonight's menu?

rows.Speaker: Josef
rows.Line: Y-Yes... You mentioned how it was far too bland last time, so I decided to make a few changes...

rows.Speaker: Josef
rows.Line: Bugs don't maintain their flavor well. To compensate, I made a sauce out of the shells of some poisonous bugs that I had to painstakingly peel off and grind up...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I have eaten quite a few poisonous bugs in my time, but a powder made out of their shells is indeed a new one...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Nicely done, Josef♥ I expect nothing less from such a great cook. Please, add it to tonight's menu.

rows.Speaker: Josef
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you very much.
If you'll excuse me, I need to go back to preparing.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe. I simply cannot wait for dinner tonight...

rows.Speaker: Josef's Voice
rows.Line: Wah?! Ow!!

rows.Speaker: Josef's Voice
rows.Line:
Arrgh!
What's a banana peel doing out here...?

rows.Speaker: Pollo's Voice
rows.Line: Hehehe.

rows.Speaker: Arte's Voice
rows.Line:
You fell for it again!!
What an idiot!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Ah, them again...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Everything Josef made was so unique and delicious...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Then, he gave me the greatest spice I could ask for...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Love...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I was blind to it at first, but I would soon realize that he was the one. My old flame.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: He came to me and...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Ah, I will never forget...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: That night we spent together, as well as when we shared a meal while in my room...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Because of my deal with that demon, a sort of euphoric sensation came over me after tasting his poisoned soup.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: But my lover, Carlos, had some as well, so that we could die together...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Unfortunately, my contract prevented me from dying, while he soon passed away.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: But he left me the greatest ingredient of all.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Himself! My “lover”...!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Ahh... Ahhhh...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Mmm... That was astounding...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Delicious beyond belief...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: My “lover”. The only one in this entire world, and my sole opportunity to truly enjoy him...!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I would like for you to feel even just a fraction of the delight I felt that time...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Ah...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: “They” may have been quite tasty as well...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
Hehe. Oh, not Arte and Pollo.
There is no denying that they were very good.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: But before I knew it, there was nobody left in my manor except for me, my empty stomach and...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
There, there...
You can rest a while here.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: So precious...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
(Our baby...
Seeing you sleep always warms my heart...)

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: (And my stomach could not be emptier...)

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: You must consume this child or face death...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Ah, “demon”, long time no see.

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: Your powers have weakened.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Oh, is that so?

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: Yes. You must consume this child to save yourself. You must hurry...

rows.Speaker: Baby
rows.Line: Zzz...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I refuse...

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: What?! Why?!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I cannot explain why.

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: You will die if you do not!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Again, I refuse.

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: Are these your emotions talking...?

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line:
Now, eat!
Without “food”, what would you have left?!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I said, “No.”

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: Eat! Devour! Consume!!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I! Will! Not!!

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: No, you must eat! Nothing else in this world will sate your lust for food!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Are you sure about that?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I see something just as good... Right in front of me.

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: What...?! N-No...!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Now then...

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: Do not be a fool! Stop! No!!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
I will consume myself.
Along with you, “demon”...

rows.Speaker: Demon
rows.Line: N-Nooo!!

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe. I simply cannot wait to see how you taste♥

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: That will be it for today's “meal”...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: I'm glad to see that you enjoyed everything as well.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Oh, are you wondering how I am still here even after I devoured myself...?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: It really is quite strange, no?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line:
By the way...
My stomach is grumbling...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe. I suppose anyone would feel hungry after hearing these kinds of stories.

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: How would you feel about hearing another story of the like?

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehe. Do not worry, satisfaction is guaranteed♥

rows.Speaker: Banica
rows.Line: Hehehe...
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku & MEIKO
rows.Line: A-America...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, Mr. Riley personally invited us to come and visit his park.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup♪ And we're gonna learn all about what makes it such a fun place☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see. That's wonderful!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It really is! I mean, America...
As in the U.S.A!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The United States of America indeed...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The land of the free that's also known as the melting pot of the world.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's so cool!
But isn't it really, really far away?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! There's a big ocean between here and there. It's not like you can swim to get there, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah, swimming's not really an option...
We have a long flight ahead of us as it is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup. It's so far away that we go back in time a day on the way there, and we jump ahead a day on our way back!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?! You're gonna go backwards and forwards by a day?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I was surprised too when my big brothers first told me!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I-Is it some kind of magic?
Are you sure the “S” doesn't stand for “Sorcery”?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
She could be right.
I mean, it's sunny over where when it's night over here, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
MEIKO...
Please try not to get the wrong idea.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As far as I can tell, she's just having a little fun with this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, too easy?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway... There's no magic or sorcery involved, Rin, Len. It's because we have to cross the “International Date Line” to get there...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, we should tell Luka about our trip too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Ah, Luka's probably asleep right now, so I'll be sure to tell her later♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure you all still have lots of packing to do. We wouldn't want any of you to forget anything, so don't let us keep you up!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. You can always let us know later once you're all settled.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, later it is!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So Tsukasa and the others will be going a long way overseas to visit Riley Dream Park...♪

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Yay... Mhm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Were you listening at all, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Yes. A fun visit...
To sheep land...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You mean, dreamland?! Not the United States?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, this is more business than pleasure from what I understand.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But we were talking about seeing what this theme park is like if we do get a chance, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds fun.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
It certainly does.
However, we'll still need to make sure that they get to learn as much as they can.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Does that sound alright with everyone?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can't wait to fly on an airplane☆

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Me too! Me too!
I really wanna see what's outside the window while they're flying♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, I can't wait to see what everything's like from way above the clouds!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hm... The clouds...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. They sound so nice and fluffy...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Luka, you can't sleep on... Nevermind...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Unfortunately...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Emu's brothers are going to be with them during their flight, so we may not be able to join them on the plane.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... That's too bad...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aww, I was really looking forward to seeing the sky from up there.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, we can always ride the flying train, so let's turn that frown upside down!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All we have to do is to ask it to go a little higher than normal, and it'll be just like we're flying on an airplane♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, you're right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow☆ Great idea, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Isn't it?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Nice save, MEIKO.
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's okay. I was just making up for teasing them about that other thing earlier.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. The first sights we see really could be of the United States by the time we're notified.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Very true! We have it easy by contrast since we don't have to worry about any luggage♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh no! I was thinking about which snacks we should take on our flight...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But does this mean they won't be necessary?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, I still want snacks...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then, why don't we take some on the train to better simulate our in-flight experience?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that'd be perfect!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I'd like that as well.
I'll even be able to have some while napping on a comfy cloud.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Again, clouds over there don't really work like that! Also, where are your manners?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Haha.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, we're going to start handing out the gifts that Tsukasa and the others brought back for us♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Plushies, if you'll please form an orderly line.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Hehe. I want some snacks, so I'll take these!

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: I'll take... This bandana.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sure, let me tie that on for you♪
Stay still for a second...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, our doggie friend here has one around its neck too. You two could match...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know! Why don't I tie yours the same way?

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And... All done♪

rows.Speaker: Doggie Plushie
rows.Line: Hey, that looks pretty good on you.

rows.Speaker: Kitty Plushie
rows.Line: It does? Thanks!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Phew... I believe that's everything.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, we had just enough for everyone...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Says the person who was dozing off part way through.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, America was much more fun than I anticipated.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. We did get to see quite a bit of that park.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, we did! The show we saw was absolutely breathtaking, while all the rides and attractions let you dive into their own individual stories or worlds♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not only that, Tsukasa and the others seemed to also make some profound realizations.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, Emu especially...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
She knows what she carries now.
She understands just how “important” she is to everyone else around her.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I've decided to hang on to my dreams while learning to balance them with reality!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: If my dreams ever start getting too big, I promise to take a step back to see if it's really possible...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And if I start putting down my own ideas too much, I'll just crawl into bed and come up with more while I'm asleep...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I'm so glad for her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But balancing your dreams with reality seems so hard.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'd say I'm dreaming for twenty and in reality for four.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Twenty and four...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah... Do you mean that you're asleep for twenty hours a day but awake for four?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Correct, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This isn't quiz time!
Sloths and pandas live more active lives than you!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But Luka's right in saying that it's challenging to balance your dreams with reality.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: True...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I want them to dream big and as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: My favorite part about them is how they're so happy-go-lucky in terms of what kinds of shows they do and how they present them♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I feel really happy whenever they just get to be themselves!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're usually pretty hands-on when it comes to motivating everyone, but it's nice seeing you sit back and watch like this from time to time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? Is that so?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. When you were handing out gifts to the plushies just now, you had this incredibly warm and gentle expression on your face.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: On top of that, you were the one who first realized that there was a child in distress while we were in the U.S.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That caught my attention because it seemed odd that someone was crying in a place that's supposed to be full of smiles and laughter.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It could also be that my ears are more sensitive to those kinds of sounds because this SEKAI's filled with so much joy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... In that case...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Waahhh... Waahhh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Uh, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Waahhh. I'm so sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Where could MEIKO be...? Her lap would make the perfect pillow right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. So she says, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wh-What do you want me to say?
You expect me to take care of a big baby like her?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Sob*
 MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you... Fine.
Just for a little while, alright?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you♪
I'll be able have some wonderful dreams now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Is that what you actually meant by what you said earlier?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And this is that photo...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Kohane, An, thank you for waiting. Here's your cafe au lait with cream and honey, and your milk tea.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mmm... It's like you always know how to make the tea you brew have this great aroma, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin, would you like some more juice?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, I'm okay!
More importantly, MEIKO, you should look at this photo.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What photo?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, it's this photo...
It's the cherry blossom tree in the park where we usually practice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Look at that. You can see some little, pink buds. They're so cute.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I guess that means it's almost spring.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Cherry blossoms in other places have already started blooming, so this one should follow suit pretty soon.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Cherry blossoms sound so nice.
I wish we could get a taste of spring like you guys.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... A taste of spring, huh...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (In that case...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO, I'm done cleaning the cups and saucers.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you, Rin. I appreciate the help.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome!
Is that all for today?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'll be using the rest of this time to come up with new menu items.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! New menu items?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That's right.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I thought it'd be nice to make some pink drinks and such based on the cherry blossom buds we saw in that photo.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And remember what you said, Rin?
Don't you want to get a taste of spring?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I do! Oh, can I help come up with ideas for your menu?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Of course!
I was actually going to ask you the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you so much, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's my pleasure.
Why don't we start by brainstorming together?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, that should be more than enough.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We came up with so many! Hot sandwiches that look like cherry blossom petals, pink crepes and a cherry blossom chiffon cake!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. We should keep cherry blossom pancakes in mind for Akito too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
As for drinks...
It's starting to warm back up but it still feels dry out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Kohane and the others usually like to stop by after practice, so why don't we put the drink menu together first?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! They gotta be pink since it's gonna be all about cherry blossoms!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. We could try using strawberry syrup in a slightly clever way to give our drinks that pink tone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO, look! This is all nice and pink now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hey, look at that.
Let's give it a taste...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, so close!
The strawberry flavor's still too overpowering.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You think so too?
Alright, we'll just have to cut back on the syrup somehow.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, here's our second new menu item. A cherry blossom smoothie.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh wow! The whipped cream on top even looks kinda pink!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Let's give it a taste!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How is it...? I tried suppressing the sweetness a bit to smoothen out how it tastes...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This is so good!
But personally, I think the whipped cream should be a little sweeter.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, I'll try making the next batch a little sweeter.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow... My mouth tastes so sugary now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Let me pour you a nice palette cleanser.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay. Thanks, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Do you always have to eat and drink this much to come up with new menu items?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I remember this process being really tough the other time I helped you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Getting to try everything is nice, but it all starts to taste the same after a while on top of my tummy getting full.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Some of my experiments will fail completely, but I still have to take responsibility and eat them. For example, pancakes that don't end up tasting very good.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That can't be easy.
How are you able to keep coming up with new things for your menu...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because there's nothing better than seeing everyone trying my new creations and saying, “This is delicious!”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, that's all it takes...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, that's all it takes.
I became hooked after my first few attempts.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Haha! Then, I hope the others say the same for what we're making right now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too. But we still have to keep trying for that to happen.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And here's your palette cleanser.
Let's get right back to it after we've had a chance to rest.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay! I'm gonna do my best too!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, here you are.
A cherry blossom smoothie and a cherry blossom latte.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thank you very much, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And here's your guys' order, Akito.
Cherry blossom pancakes, cherry blossom cookies and my house blend.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Perfect. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka and KAITO are asking for seconds, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, I'd love to try some of those pancakes!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure thing. Just give me a minute.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Looks like your cherry blossom stuff's a big hit, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it's nice to see that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (This was what I was hoping to see. Their smiles.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How do you feel after seeing everyone smile like this, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe. Waaay too good!
Now I kinda see why you're so hooked on this feeling, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that reminds me.
There's something I've been meaning to ask all of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Ask us, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did you come up with more new menu items?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, it's not that. I'm wondering how you all feel about this cafe's interior.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We went through the trouble of coming up with cherry blossom-themed menu items, so I thought it'd be nice to make the cafe feel more springlike.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: More springlike...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What if you put some cherry blossoms or other spring flowers on display?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That sounds lovely! You could make the whole cafe bloom!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I know! How about raining flower petals?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I just happen to know someone with a device that can make that happen...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hold up. Raining flower petals sounds like a bit much, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree... I wouldn't want any to fall into people's food or drinks...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Aww, even if they're edible?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I may consider it if you're willing to help me clean everything up afterwards, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Guh...
I wasn't thinking that far ahead.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Um, what if you used cups, saucers and placemats with flower petal designs? Wouldn't that be nice and cute?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, you could brighten up the place just by having matching tableware and stuff.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that does sound nice.
There are these cups and placemats that I've been meaning to use too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'd like to come up with some background music that makes it feel like spring's arrived.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mind if I try creating a mix for your cafe, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, be my guest.
If anything, I should be the one asking you to do this.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ah, wonderful. I promise to do my best.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
This is great, MEIKO.
Everyone's coming up with so many ideas.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It really is! Why don't we set aside a day to remodel this place together?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Yeah!
Remodeling day

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for taking the time to join me here today. Let's all do our best to give this place the spring makeover it deserves.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm gonna do everything I can since you're always there for me, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me three♪ Also, what are we supposed to be doing?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You really don't remember, Luka?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're in charge of making the paper flowers!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right. Here, look at these.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What are these? Square fans? No, that doesn't seem right. We're supposed to turn these into flowers?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow! Look at these placemats! They're adorable!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know, right? I shied away from using them until now because I was afraid they'd clash with the cafe's vibe...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we're decorating the place with flowers now, so these placemats should go great alongside them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. While we're at it, let's also take a look at the cups and saucers.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's about how it goes. What do you think after hearing it all the way through?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I can't believe you went with a full spring mix. I was expecting it to sound jazzier or something, you know?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I thought about doing that as well, but this just burst into my head when I began thinking about animals hibernating in winter...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Animals hibernating in winter?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! It opens with a piano solo for that very reason.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Just think about it. What do animals do when they wake from such a long slumber?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. It begins with a piano solo, but more and more instruments get added to the mix as time progresses to show that these animals are finally awake.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, now it makes sense.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I usually expect your mixes to start off with a big bang, so this gradual growth in sound sort of felt new to me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. But what he's come up with seems much more suited for a cafe, no?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I get what you mean. It has presence but it's not in your face about it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank goodness! I was worried about how it'd turn out after doing some experimenting, but it was worth the risk.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay, we'll start setting the tables using these placemats and cups!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (They all seem to be enjoying themselves.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I hesitated to put up a lot of decorations since this place has such a simple interior...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But I want this place to feel welcoming and make it so everyone can talk about what's on their mind...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Giving it a brighter and warmer look may actually help with achieving that goal.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(And that SEKAI... That tree...
It glistened with everyone's thoughts and feelings.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I want to keep doing what I can to make sure they keep shining for as long as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: MEIKO, we're done setting the tables!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Thank you both very much!
I'll be right there.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you very much for the delicious lunch and coffee, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm glad you enjoyed it.
Good luck with practice.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Thank you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. They seemed to have no problem getting through all the colorful veggies I included in the special lunch.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Although, tomatoes and carrots would've gone a long way in terms of balancing out the colors...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (At the same time, it'd be pretty mean of me to include them since I know certain people would rather not have those things.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, welcome.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? I thought Kohane and the others would be here. Did I just miss them...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they went off to practice just a moment ago.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But since you're here, would you like some coffee?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes, that sounds nice.
I'll take a cafe au lait.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You got it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, An and Kohane are supposed to work as models tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: As models?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. An's playing a bride with Kohane supporting her as a bridesmaid.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, An's the bride?
What kind of dress do you think she's going to wear?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I knew you'd be curious.
So, I asked them to bring by some pictures once they're ready.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good call.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, one thing is bugging me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A long time ago, I saw an actual bride on Vivid Street...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Like you, MEIKO!
She seemed so beautiful, mature and collected!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm reminded every time of that moment when I think about what a bride is... I don't really fit the bill, do I?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, she believes she doesn't fit the bill...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. Speaking of which, Miku, what image comes to mind when you think about brides?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hm? Nothing all that specific...
Someone who's dazzling and full of joy...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I also think the individual matters quite a bit when it comes to “being a bride”.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Right...
I sure hope An doesn't take what she said too far...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: If you feel the need, why don't you visit them during the shoot tomorrow?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But that means I'd have to close up shop...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't worry. I'll keep things running while you're gone.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, Miku, you will?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Well, to be fair, I'll only be able to serve coffee and the sandwiches I've learned how to make.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Th-Thank you, Miku.
I really appreciate the offer...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But Miku using the kitchen knives all by herself... No, I can't go knowing that it could actually happen...!)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hmm... I guess just sandwiches and coffee wouldn't really count as keeping this place running, huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's not entirely true...
However, I wouldn't want you getting hurt doing something you're not really used to...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Looks like my visit's a bit out of the question now.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hiya! We dropped by for a visit!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Welcome, Rin.
Oh...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: MEIKO, can I get my usual...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
KAITO! Perfect!
There's something I need you to do for me!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Me?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! You're the only person I can ask, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO and I were just talking about how she could make some time to visit An and Kohane tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And if it'd be okay for me to keep this place running in her stead...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Wait, Miku, you?! In charge?!
Does that include serving the food...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, but all I'd be able to serve is coffee and the sandwiches MEIKO taught me to make.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you sure about this, MEIKO?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, I really appreciate Miku's offer... But I'd rather not see her get hurt by trying to do something she's not used to...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I really don't think you have to get so worried about me making some sandwiches.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hold it right there!
They're not just “some sandwiches” in this case!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, right. MEIKO does put a lot of thought into them, so it's wrong for me to devalue them in any way...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Huh? Um, yes! That's right!
As long as you understand.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, KAITO... Would you mind keeping Miku company tomorrow while she keeps this place running?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd prefer it if you were here as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, understood...
The two of us should be able to handle everything!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you so much, KAITO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
KAITO's gonna be running things?!
Len and I might have to stop by tomorrow to see that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Wait, you're not going to help?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, what's the point of running a shop if you don't have any customers?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Point taken!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for making such a kind offer, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Don't mind me.
I just ask that you be there for An and the others tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I promise to do just that.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO, can I get a refill for my coffee?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Would you like some as well, Rin, Len?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No, I'm okay!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think I'll take a refill!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I can't wait to have some of that chocolate cake.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, you...
Just give me a minute.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, I'll take care of the empty cups. Why don't you get that cake ready?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay. In that case, they're all yours.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, here you are!
My special chocolate cake.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Luka
rows.Line: Woohoo!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So this is the chocolate cake Akito was talking about!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This is all I've been thinking about today! So, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO, hang on.
I have to repay you for keeping an eye on things for me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here's some of my special rum raisin ice cream.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Are you sure?! Yay!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Good for you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wait, keeping an eye on things? What happened? I would've helped out if only I'd known about it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Hello!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really?! You and Kohane did some modeling together, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes, we did. MEIKO even paid me a visit after I said that I wasn't all that confident about being a model.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? All I did was go over to see what you two looked like in dresses.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And despite whatever troubles you were having, I'm glad you figured out how to just be yourself in the end.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No, that was all because Shizuku and... I mean, the other people modeling with us helped me realize that I should just be me for the shoot...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Singing with Kohane also helped solidify the image in my head of who I want to be.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so glad that I was able to help An too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, thank you very much for suggesting that I do something for her that only I can!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So what kind of pictures did you guys take? I really wanna see!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, we've got some right here!
That's actually sort of why we stopped by!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, An, you're so beautiful!
And this dress looks amazing on you!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. The makeup artist really worked her magic for me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Totally.
The same goes for you, Kohane. You look adorable!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Really? Thanks, Rin.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: By the way, what did the entry for that photography contest look like?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that one... Let's see... Here it is!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hm? Is that a cat sitting on top of your skirt, An?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that's Vivi, the cat that everyone on Vivid Street just absolutely adores...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We found her stuck in a tree as she was about to fall and I managed to catch her using my dress.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which is why all of you seem so relieved in this photo. You were glad to see that this cat was safe.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hang on. Weren't you guys supposed to be taking pictures of a wedding? I mean, you got all dressed up for one.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We did, but this was chosen because it really captured the moment when “happiness brings everyone together”.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Not only that, An, you literally jumped into these shrubs to save this cat. I'd expect no less from you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Happiness bringing everyone together, huh...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That explains why I felt so much warmth coming from the pictures you brought over for us to see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they were all incredibly wonderful.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (And this warmth...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Singing with Kohane also helped solidify the image in my head of who I want to be.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I'm so glad that I was able to help An too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So, thank you very much for suggesting that I do something for her that only I can!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (It feels an awful lot like that sensation from a second ago.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, there you guys are!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Welcome!
This spot's free.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, KAITO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Will it be the usual, you two?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I could actually go for a sandwich right now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, coming right up.
Coast

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I was worried about what would happen for a second there, but I'm glad that they were able to find both food and water.>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <So am I. Emu in particular did a magnificent job of discovering a watering hole after just seeing some birds land in the bushes.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <All that's left for them is to whip up a delicious dinner♪>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, I think I'm starting to get hungry!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, me too!>

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Speaking of which, you've all been with us for most of the day. You should also find something to eat instead of just helping us.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Okay♪>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Oh, wanna go forage for food like the others are doing?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, that sounds fun! Let's go wake Luka up and see if we can find some wild mountain herbs!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hang on... There aren't any mountains or anything in SEKAI, are there?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. If we can't find them, we can make one♪>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! You're so cool, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. If you can't find a mountain, make one, eh? I see that the scale of your ideas is as big as ever.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, look! It's Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: Welcome back, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We're back, Robo-Nene!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank goodness we're back at base camp...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hm? Is it just me or are things getting really dark all of a sudden...?>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Uh oh... What if...?!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh...?! W-Wait!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What happened?! Why were we sent back just now?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that the battery on Tsukasa's phone just ran out...

rows.Speaker: Miku & Len
rows.Line: Whaaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Welcome back, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Luka, this is the wrong time to be napping! The battery on Tsukasa's phone just ran out!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Are they gonna be okay?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, they managed to find food and water, but they're likely going to be on that desert island for a while.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, I know! Why don't we set up our own camp just in case they need a place to take shelter?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Set up our own camp...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes. We'll need to set up a camp big enough for five in case Emu's brother joins them♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! And we'll be helping Tsukasa and the others!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Alright, I'm gonna do my best to help too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, let's start gathering things that are edible in SEKAI and set up a sleeping area!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The mats we use during practices could work as substitute mattresses.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Great idea! Let's split up and get gathering♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Guys, look!
I brought over some snacks that I'd been saving for later!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO, mind if I use this adorable fabric as a cover for the mats?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Oh, like sheets?
That's a good idea. Thank you for doing that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Awesome! Luka, Len, let's get the mats ready together!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Our camp's coming along really nicely♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, it is.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I need to thank you, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? What's gotten into you all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, it's just... Your suggestion to set up a camp made Miku and the others so enthusiastic, didn't it?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You seem to have a knack for coming up with the right idea when we need it most.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
So...
Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're welcome♪
But I believe I deserve a little more praise than that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, I've already come up with some different uses for our camping gear in the event that Tsukasa and the others tell us that they don't need to take shelter here.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, mind telling me more?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not now. You'll just have to wait to find out♪
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, I'm glad that our camp turned out so nice♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yay☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Great work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Between the tarp we made from the stage curtains, the practice mats that we turned into beds and all this food, our camp looks spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Doesn't it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, but... It's kinda too bad that we didn't have enough blankets to go around.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Right. Not even after taking some from the bed I use for when I take naps throughout the day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. We should be fine then.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: MEIKO, thanks for waiting!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hm? Hey, it's the plushies!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Did you ask something of them, MEIKO? Mind explaining for us?

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: We can be the bedding!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah! We're nice and fluffy, so we can lie down and become bedding for everyone!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see... Yes, you'd certainly make for some nice bedding. If anything, you'd be warm and cozy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, they would. I might just take a nap with them right now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Was this also your idea, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, it was!
I tried coming up with a workaround after Len mentioned that we may not have enough bedding!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now, we just need to see if Tsukasa and the others are okay...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...! Did you guys feel that just now?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I felt it too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Yeah, me too!
Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, our connection may be back!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes, it might be!
Hello?! Tsukasa?! Everyone?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank goodness they were able to call for help.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not only that, they still get to do their show as ambassadors despite the change in schedule.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm so glad for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Same!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But we won't be able to go see their show...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There isn't a whole lot we can do about that since Emu and the others' phones are broken.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Luckily, we were able to connect to Tsukasa's phone...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But it sounded like the hologram feature wasn't working properly, so his phone may also need fixing.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh no. Doesn't that mean we won't be able to see them until their phones get fixed...? That's so sad...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
We'll just have to be a bit patient.
I'm sure they'll find a way to have them repaired in short order and visit us soon after.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, hang on...
What should we do about our camp?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There's no need for them to take shelter here anymore, so I guess we have to pack everything up now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not necessarily. We went through the trouble of setting all this up, so we should make use of it♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Now I understand what you meant by finding a different use for our camp after realizing that they wouldn't need to take shelter here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That sounds lovely.
I think I'll start by taking a little nap on one of the beds made out of practice mats.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, me too!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, me three!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, no fair! I wanna try it too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha! In that case, let's use everything we set up to have a little campout!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Plushies!
Wanna be my bedding?!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line:
Sure, just lie down on that bed for us!
And... Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Whoa! The plushies are dogpiling on top of Miku!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No fair...

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Len, Rin, do you two also wanna give it a try? There's still lots and lots of us, so we're ready whenever!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?! I wanna try!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Alright, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
This is so amazing!
I'm literally covered in plushies!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
They seem so nice and fluffy.
I might just ask them to do that for me next.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I'll go after that!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Haha. You guys, that tickles...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. This is turning into a fun and lively campout already.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, it is! It just goes to show that SEKAI needs to be full of smiles and laughter♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, let's join in on the fun!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, let's call it a day.
Please make sure to stretch on your own later.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sounds good. Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whew... Another exhausting day...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: All the more reason to stretch well.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: She's right. It's important for us to take good care of our bodies.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Definitely!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Miku, Luka...
I kinda want to keep working on that part we just did...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Sure, of course.
The part where we weren't quite in sync, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, that part bothered me as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We'll be joining them to practice that part for a bit, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, have fun♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hey, KAITO.
Maybe we should keep working on our part too.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right. Then, why don't we follow suit and start with some fine-tuning.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What do you plan on doing, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... Well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO!
Sorry, there's actually something I need to ask you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: KAITO, I'll meet up with you guys after I talk to Airi.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, see you then.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry about this, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's okay. We were just about done practicing. What was it that you wanted to ask?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm in the middle of coming up with ideas for our training camp and was hoping that you could tell me more about how you guys trained.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I'd like to hear as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too! I've been practicing on my own in preparation for our solo show, so we can use what you guys did as reference!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, I'd be more than happy to explain!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We started with some basic strength training drills, including sit-ups, push-ups, squats and some lat exercises.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: After that, we did some running and worked on increasing our lung capacity by blowing up balloons♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Eep...!
Just hearing that is making my arms and legs sore!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What happened to all that enthusiasm you had just a second ago, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-But... It's so much harder than what I was expecting to hear...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By the way, how many sit-ups and such did you have everybody do?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
At least 100.
And two sets of those if possible...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-At least 100?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If I did that, my abs would pop out and fly away somewhere!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's a bit hard to imagine, but it might be fun to see that happen in real life...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Two sets if possible...
That sounds pretty difficult.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I think I can do 100, but two sets of those may be tough.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait a second...
Don't tell me you all can do 100 sit-ups...

rows.Speaker: Haruka, Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes.
Of course.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Guh... About thirty's my limit...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's perfectly okay, Minori. There's no need to feel bad.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know 100 is a big number, but it's not actually about quantity.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. The goal isn't to do 100 sit-ups.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The goal is to work up the courage to push yourself to and beyond your limit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Courage...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Of course, it's important to complete the reps you set for yourself as you train.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: However, that doesn't mean you have to do everything on your first try. In time, as that courage within you grows, you'll be able to reach those numbers.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, your first goal will be to actually try pushing yourself to your limit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...!
Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're welcome♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Do you think you'll be able to apply this to your training camp, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks a bunch, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not just for all these training ideas, but for your reasoning too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad I could help.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If there's anything else you need, please feel free to stop in and ask.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? Then, I might just take you up on that.
Beach

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry, guys...
On second thought, I'm gonna go check up on Minori! I'm really worried about her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A-Airi...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I had a feeling that Airi'd be the one to go after her.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. And it's going to be a very special moment for her since these kinds of experiences only happen once during your life...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On top of that, Minori's lifelong wish has been to become an idol, so this is her dream stage.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Especially since Airi gained fame as a variety idol. As a result, she began losing opportunities to perform on stage.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She more than anyone else probably knows the joy and hardships of actually performing on stage.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Shizuku, maybe we should also go and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm also a little worried about Minori, but since Airi's going over to see her, she should be in good hands...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: There was a time when I also struggled to learn dance routines and didn't really know what to do. That was when Airi came to help.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, let's leave this one to her.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Especially considering how I probably won't know what else to say other than, “You don't have to push yourself so hard.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <If that's the case, let's have Airi handle the advice-giving while we watch from afar.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, since worrying and waiting are worse for your skin than the salty sea air.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right.
Does that sound good, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: MEIKO, Luka, thank you both.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<There's no need to thank us.
For now, let's go find Minori and Airi♪>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, look. There they are.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank goodness. They're both smiling.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, and Airi seems to be telling her something...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Let's try scooting a little closer without interrupting their conversation.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <I can hear more of what they're saying now... I think they're talking about you, Shizuku.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: About me...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, maybe they're talking about when we were still in training...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Oh, Minori just stood up...
To do a pose...?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Are they gonna work on the dance she was practicing?>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <If so, they'll probably need something to quench their thirst.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's give them some space and go get them some drinks.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Do you think they're still practicing...? Oh...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. Looks like they've finished practicing.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And she seems to be taking Airi's advice well...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
You were right, Shizuku. I'm glad we let Airi handle this.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for suggesting that we go and take a look, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <You're wel...>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Uh oh! Everyone, hide!
Airi's going to see us if we don't!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She smiled after looking this way, so I suspect she already knows that we're here.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <D-Don't worry! We can just act like we don't know anything and say, “Oh, there you are!” That should work, right?!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Nice one, Rin! Let's try that!>

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Haha... Still, it may be better to simply just walk over.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, there she is! Hey, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Did you need something?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um... They said they wanted to celebrate with you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Celebrate?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, it's your anniversary today, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Exactly. And to mark the occasion, we brought some snacks, juice and a lil' cake!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anniversary...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. You do so much for us, so we wanted to give something back.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But...if you don't want it, we'll leave you alone.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hold on! We can't give up that easily after all the time we spent planning this!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So um, are you interested...? We don't have to if we're being a nuisance...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's fine. Let's do it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, you have to reconsider...! Wait, what?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm not so heartless that I'd put your gifts to waste. So... Where are we doing it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Allow us to escort you to the venue♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Everyone has a drink, right? Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Kanade, Mafuyu, Mizuki & Ena
rows.Line: MEIKO, happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin, Len & Luka
rows.Line: Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Here's to MEIKO, who we're so grateful to!
Cheers♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Cheers...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We brought a lot of different snacks, so take your pick.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I want something sweet.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, me too...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, why don't you try this? Look, it's in a bright red packet, like a strawberry.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: S-Strawberry...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nice try, but we can all see where it says “RED HOT” in big letters.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There are some chocolate marshmallows here.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think I prefer that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, what a shame. Will no one share these with me?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a no from me. Anyway, why are those even in there? I'm pretty sure I took them out of the cart because I knew no one would want them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I bought them myself afterward♪
I thought it would be fun to “spice” up the party!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Luka, I'll try them with you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You all went shopping together?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. We figured that all the snacks and juice would be bulky, so the four of us went to the mall.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Why do you ask...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
...No reason.
Thank you for doing that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, it's time! Everyone, MEIKO's anniversary show is about to start!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're going to sing, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nope, it's the MEIKO from where we live! I brought my tablet so we could all watch together.
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: MEIKO

rows.Line: <And all of you watching over the livestream, are you ready?>

rows.Line: These are the versions of us from their world... I'm smiling so much.

rows.Line: And Luka and MEIKO look like such good friends.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, who said we're on bad terms?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We're not. Our conversations just go nowhere.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's not true either. We're both just stubborn about our opinions.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha... I guess so.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, this song...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's Kanade for you, sharp as a pin! They commissioned an artist to write this song especially for today's show.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Was it on the CD that Hoshino lent you?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. I recognized the melody straight away.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It has...kind of a warmth to it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It does.

rows.Line: (She's MEIKO too, but she's entirely different from me.)

rows.Line: (“I” can also sing warm songs like this then.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (What an odd feeling.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, I suppose this song is to her liking.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, I'm sure of it.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, MEIKO.
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to my anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And all of you watching over the livestream, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Look! Already we're getting so many messages!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're right! Whoa, they're coming in too fast to even read! KAITO, you do it!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: What?! I can't read them this fast either!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hahaha. I guess everyone is bringing the energy for MEIKO's special day!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Well, we're gonna bring just as much energy, so try to keep up! Okay guys?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here we go! We'll start with this song!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Everybody got their glow sticks?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Set them to bright red and show your love for MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Whoa, those messages just keep coming. Everyone watching the livestream must be radiating energy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, they must be. This is a special day for them just as much as it is for MEIKO♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That doesn't mean we can slack off though. I say we give them what we've got and outshine even MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that's some big talk right there! Show me what you've got, if you can!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did you all hear that? It's us five versus MEIKO then!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What?! Hold up, that's not fair, is it?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for coming today!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your support means the world to me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We've reached the end of the show, but before we say goodbye... I have something to say.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, was this planned?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: No, I don't think it was...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, first up is Luka!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You have a gentle way about you that always puts me at ease. So that I can do the same for you one day, please let me know if you're ever in a bind.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And of course, thank you for doing so much to make today's show happen!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
MEIKO...
Hehe, you're very welcome.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: KAITO. You're kind, you look after people and we can always depend on you. You're proactive about having fun...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But you're clueless about the weirdest things! But I like that you're uncomplicated like that, so never change!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hahaha. That started off so nice. If only you'd finished earlier.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin and Len. You two give me so much energy and joy! Not to mention tons of interesting and unexpected ideas!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You guys have your fights, but I'll be there to help when you can't make up, so come talk to me, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And finally... Miku!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I love that you're so authentic and straightforward. But know that you can lean on me too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If there's ever anything I can help with, please let me know. I'll show up no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO...! Okay, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So typical, MEIKO. Only ever thinking about us...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! You should enjoy the limelight more!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We have a whole lot of nice things to say to you too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's right! So listen up, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO! Once again, happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for always looking out for us. I love how kind and dependable you are!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, MEIKO♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You're always helping us out, but never hesitate to ask us for help! If you're ever in trouble, just leave it to me!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's right, and I'll be there to help too. Whatever the problem is, we'll fix it together!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So if you ever need amazing ideas, or you've had a fight with someone, come to us, okay?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: MEIKO, thank you for what you said earlier. It made me really happy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You mentioned more of my strengths than my weaknesses, and you told me my absent-mindedness is endearing. I hope to be your friend for a long time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: MEIKO. From my heart, happy anniversary.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I also get so much energy from your songs and your words. What's more, you fill me with such a giving spirit.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's just one of the many reasons you're so great. Hehe. Let's stay friends forever and ever.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Okay, now let's all say it as one!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You guys...
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's such an honor to spend my days with you all. Every day is filled with fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, I feel truly happy knowing how many people have shown up to celebrate my anniversary.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you so much, everybody! I'm counting on your continued support!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your advice.
I have a much better idea of what to do now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You're very welcome♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: See you later, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, see you!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Haruka seemed much better compared to when she arrived just earlier.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'm glad we could help.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I didn't realize how tough it could be to decide whether or not to appear on TV...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Me neither...
Especially since it's a big opportunity for MORE MORE JUMP! to really increase their name recognition.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it is. But Shizuku and Airi have had some bad experiences in the past...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which means it's incredibly important right now for them to give this appearance a lot of thought. For them and the sake of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But as things stand... I'd like to see them on TV.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As long as they remain true to their feelings, I believe that everyone will hear their message loud and clear.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, me too♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, they're really going to be on TV...! They've come such a long way.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they have. Former top idols being in this group has also attracted a lot of attention.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And successfully putting on a solo show has only given them a bigger boost.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
That's so awesome!
I wish I could go on TV! I bet it'd be so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
