rows.Line: Oh, by the way, Rin, what kind of program would you like to be on?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hmm... A music one!
I wanna sing and dance and make everybody smile!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I see.
That sounds like a primetime music program.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, what about you guys?
What kinds of TV shows would you want to be on?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think I'd like to appear on a variety show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How fun would it be to do one of those quiz segments and the winner gets to perform a song?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that does sound fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Right?
Oh, but I'm also interested in documentaries.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I can see it now.
“It was a long road that was full of obstacles, but these girls overcame all of that to reach this stage.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It'd be so dramatic too! With tears, laughter, everything!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. You really do love those kinds of stories, huh♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I do!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: How about you, Miku, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hmm... TV...
Oh, it might be fun to do an on-location one!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Traveling to various cities, interviewing the people who live there and seeing beautiful sights sounds really interesting!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see. That sounds like a fun travel show.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As for me, a show that lets me eat all kinds of delicious food to my heart's content would be perfect♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hang on one second. We were talking about what kinds of TV shows we'd all like to appear on. You just sound like someone with an empty stomach.

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Haha.
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, what do you think Len and KAITO would say if we asked them about this?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to know as well.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Variety shows may suit him, but I have a feeling that Len would want to star in a TV drama.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I remember him mentioning the other day that he wants to learn how to be a more expressive singer and hone his acting skills.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I didn't know that...! Len's really talented, so I bet he'd be a wonderful actor.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, what about KAITO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd say a show that involves animals. I have a feeling that he'd enjoy taking care of little critters.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, that sounds perfect!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now I'm curious. Why don't we go find them and ask them for ourselves?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Good idea. It'll be interesting to see if we guessed correctly♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, let's go ask them!

rows.Speaker: Luka, Miku & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah♪
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Whew...!
That should be enough practice for today.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Okay.
Thank you for letting me practice with you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Some of the things we did seemed pretty difficult at first, but it was fun to practice in a different way for a change!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You're welcome!
I had fun as well♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And there's more where that came from. You're always free to join me for another session♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Haha... I'd like to, but I'm not sure I'll be able to keep up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, welcome!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Good evening, MEIKO, Miku.
Are you two free right now?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, we just finished practicing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay...
There's something I need to tell you both.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Is this about your TV appearance?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes.
We decided to accept.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You gave this offer quite a lot of thought, so I'm glad you were able to come to a decision.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Congratulations, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I really appreciate you all giving me advice regarding this. What you said made me realize some important things.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As your fan, I want to say, “Don't worry.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Including the hope and warmth you wish to spread to others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And those things mean quite a lot to me...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, a TV appearance isn't going to easily change how I feel about all of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I agree...
You girls are who you are. Nothing is going to change that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Once again...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for taking my concern seriously and listening to what I had to say.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Miku
rows.Line: You're very welcome♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But we really didn't do all that much other than say what we felt.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's not true.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What you said, MEIKO, not only helped me reach a decision in terms of appearing on TV, but it also reminded me of my roots.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Your roots...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. The reason I wanted to become an idol in the first place...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I remembered the person who made me believe in a better tomorrow. The idol who gave me that hope.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So, there's someone who you look up to, like the way Minori looks up to you, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She's no longer an idol, but she still performs on stage from time to time and spreads cheer to everyone she meets.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. She sounds like a wonderful person.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, she is...!
The first time I met her, she was so kind and warm, and made everybody around her smile...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That feeling of warmth in my chest. The way she dazzled everyone. I still remember it all very clearly...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Being reminded of when I met her made me remember the feeling of hope she gave me. The belief that tomorrow will be a better day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Haruka...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You girls put on a successful solo show and have put forth a fantastic goal for yourselves. As a result, you're at a crossroads so to speak.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's not uncommon to lose sight of what means most to you... Why you decided to become an idol in the first place or how you felt back then...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, now might not be a bad time to look back on all that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She actually tried doing what I suggested.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Hehe. Oh, Haruka. You're such an earnest girl.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I learned from the newspaper that she was still spreading hope to others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: From the newspaper?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I had no idea what she was doing after she'd retired from being an idol...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that article showed me how she's still doing her best, and just how powerful the media can be.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So that's what helped you reach your decision.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to tell us all of this, Haruka. Rest assured, you all have our support moving forward.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, since we want to see you appear on TV and perform a show at the Dome.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. And I'd like it as well if you're all there with us every step of the way as we spread hope to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, we'll be looking forward to your continued support.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Miku
rows.Line: Of course♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO, Miku & Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Nice work today!
See you at tomorrow's show♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Our rehearsal went off without a hitch, so I'm sure everyone's going to enjoy the show tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hm? Minori...?
What are you doing here all by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... Can I ask for a favor?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, you've been trying to practice answering questions that you may be asked during your iHaz shoot, but you're not sure if you're going about it correctly?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah... That's why I kinda want to talk to someone about this, but it's pretty late and the others are probably already asleep...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Which brought you to us.
Hehe. It's nice to hear that we're reliable.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That's because you guys are.
You've helped me out so much already...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Then, don't hesitate to ask.
Especially since I want your TV appearance to lead to more and more people learning about you girls.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: M-MEIKO...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much! I really appreciate it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
“So, let's bring in our guests!
Give a big round of applause for MORE MORE JUMP!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't give up on your dreams, Minorinrin! Here's a bouquet of hope for you! Hello!
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: “Your fans helped make the outfits you're wearing today, right?”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, they did...!
We were really worried about what outfits to wear since it's our first time appearing on TV...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we decided to wear these for this appearance because we wanted to tell all our fans just how much we appreciate what they've done for us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I see...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: How did I do, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I want to do better during the actual shoot, so please don't hold back! Lay it on me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay....

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Firstly...
Your mouth was a bit all over the place.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Wah! W-Wait!
HEIKO, my heeksh! Hat hickles!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. That should loosen them up a little.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: When you were speaking just now, Minori, you sounded like you were in a big hurry.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, really. Even for the parts where you need to stop and take a breath, you rushed ahead seemingly in order to introduce yourself as quickly as you could.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She wants to do her best, but that may be causing her to become a little too anxious or flustered.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(But I understand how she feels...
Shizuku already mentioned how she wants the shoot to go well by explaining what happened between her and Cheerful * Days.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Minori, nothing good will come about if you panic.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, try focusing on saying what you want one word at a time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let's start by taking a deep breath!
Breathe in... Breathe out...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Breathe in... Breathe out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: One more time! Breathe in... Breathe out...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Breathe in... Breathe out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
“So, let's bring in our guests!
Give a big round of applause for MORE MORE JUMP!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Don't give up on your dreams, Minorinrin! Here's a bouquet of hope for you! Hello!
I'm Minori Hanasato from MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, excellent♪
You introduced yourself much better this time!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you so much, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think I have a much better idea of what I need to do now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm glad to hear that.
Then, let's keep practicing while we have some momentum!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Oh, before we do...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I came up with some questions that aren't in the script that I think they're going to ask us! Would you mind taking a look at them?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I'd love to hear any that you come up with that you think I missed!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Of course!
Let's practice as much as we can♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome back from your iHaz shoot, girls♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, how'd it go?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It went really well.
They went off-script a few times, but we managed somehow.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, Shizuku especially.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! She was so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you all very much.
But I think you did a wonderful job answering their questions considering it was your first time on TV, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. You responded well while using your own words.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. It was all thanks to MEIKO practicing with me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, you two practiced together?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, way more than that!
We practiced over and over until I got it right...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, MEIKO, thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're very welcome♪
I'm glad I could be of service.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That just leaves me learning how to answer and deal with questions that aren't in the script...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh yeah, you mentioned that you went off-script a few times.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Actually I'm interested in hearing more about how your shoot went. Would you mind telling us?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, not at all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We'll be looking forward to when it airs!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Promise to show us when it does, okay♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was asked some questions that weren't in the script and I sort of panicked.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I tried coming up with a bunch that I thought I was gonna be asked, but none of them actually came up...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
We were just as surprised as you.
I really don't think there was much you could do about that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I came up with some questions that aren't in the script that I think they're going to ask us! Would you mind taking a look at them?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, I'd love to hear any that you come up with that you think I missed!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Even after Minori came to ask for my help...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Would I have been able to give her better advice if I had a better understanding of “raw interactions” or how idols and such are presented on TV...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Oh, speaking of which...we...)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Hm? MEIKO...?
You seem concerned about something.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, there is something on my mind...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Say, would you all mind listening for a second?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Sure, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What's wrong, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I just realized something...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We primarily focus only on doing shows, yes?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Um, yeah...
I mean, we have all these stages to work with...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Some parts do resemble what you might see in a TV studio, but we have hardly any experience doing shoots and such.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which probably isn't a good thing if we're going to support the girls moving forward, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's right. They might be asked to appear on TV more and more in the future.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, they managed to figure out a way this time, but it sounded like they still struggled.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. So you're saying that we should find a way to become more familiar with the world of TV, right♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have a rough idea of what music programs that involve live performances are like, but there's more than just that, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. Travel programs, variety shows and such... We don't normally get exposed to them, but there is a chance that Minori and the others will.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Then, why don't we go on a trip?
We can even try some delicious food and give reviews about them♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. SEKAI's a very big and expansive place, so there may be stages that we haven't discovered yet.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Giving food reviews also sounds fun.
I'm very much looking forward to doing that♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (The girls have set their sights very, very high.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Which is why I'd like to give them all the support I can. So that they can achieve their goal.)
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You were faster, Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: No way! Len, you were!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Oh no...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? What's going on? Why are you all gathered here?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Rin and Len were having a footrace, but they finished at the same time...

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: We couldn't tell who actually finished first...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's why I'm telling you all, Rin definitely finished faster than I did...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Not true!
Len, you totally beat me by a nose!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's odd. They're both saying that the other person finished first... Not many people argue for their opponent.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Well, in any case...
I'll watch, so why don't you two have a remat—

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh. Hi, you guys...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Nene, welcome! Are you here by yourself?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I was hoping to go for a run here.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: For a run?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. To increase your stamina...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, but today's practice went on for longer than I was expecting. It's gotten dark already...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So I was hoping that I could do my running here to be on the safe side. Mind if I do for a bit...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's fine, of course! We were just about to have a footrace of our own!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A footrace?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yup! Nene, let's run it together!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We'd love to have you!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks. I think I'll join you, then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Great! As for your course...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You'll start at the teacups, run to the tent over there, turn around and come back. How does that sound?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm not losing this time, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right back at you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, on your marks...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Get set... Go!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Let's follow them!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What?! You're all going with them?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I was planning on waiting here, but...
Hehe. In that case, I'll join you all♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff...! Huff...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is rough... Right after practice too...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huff...! Huff...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huff...! Huff...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Hmm... It wasn't meant to be a very long course, but they all look exhausted...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Nene's coming here right after practicing, while Rin and Len just did a run a second ago.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (If any of them start to look like they're in trouble, maybe I should stop the...)

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Oofie!!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You really took a tumble there. Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah... I'm... Ow!
My leg... I think it's coming undone...

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line:
*Sob*
But I wanna keep running with everyone...

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line:
Don't worry! Here, I'll help carry you!
We can run until the end together like this!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Let's keep going!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's go, Len!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay! Plushies, you too!

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And...!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Len & MEIKO
rows.Line: We did it!

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Yay! We all finished at the same time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... We really did it, Rin, Len.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! Working together like that was a lot of fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. We even stopped caring about who actually finished first or whatever.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, does this mean you two have made up?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks for running with me, everyone. I might've given up partway through if you guys weren't there with me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel the same♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me three!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for running with us, Plushies!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Plushies
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thank you too, MEIKO.
I feel better about myself now after actually finishing that run.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's wonderful to hear!
Putting on stamina takes a lot of mental strength, so it's important to do it one step at a time!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'll keep that in mind.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I just suggested that footrace off the top of my head, but it all worked out in the end.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Must be because I'm always such a good girl♪)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehehe.
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Okay, we know what our next show is going to be. But getting everything ready won't be easy since it involves a number of large props...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I can carry anything you need!
I'll do it quick-lickety-split♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO, let us know if you want any of us to help☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We'll make or carry whatever you guys need!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I appreciate it, you two!
Still, you seem very excited about all this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is it because Tsukasa won that audition?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe. Correct!
He said it was really hard, but he managed to portray his character the way he wanted.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! So, we feel motivated to try harder ourselves.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, I think anyone would feel encouraged after hearing a story like that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, would you mind helping me carry some of the smaller props...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We need to do that first to clear space for when we move the larger ones.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay. Len, let's go!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank goodness. I was worried that you were going to ask them to move the large props right off the bat...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I appreciate them being so kind...
However, it'd be dangerous for them to try to move any of the larger ones on their own.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If only we could get our resident sheep counter to feel even a tiny fraction of what they're feeling.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, KAITO, MEIKO!
What do you want us to do?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Actually, we need to move some of these other things before we can move any of the larger props.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
So, move them out of the way☆
I'm on it♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Then, I'll keep working over here.
MEIKO, can you keep an eye on Rin and the others?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Where could Rin and Len be?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I was sure I'd run into them by now, but I don't see them anywhere...)

Hnng!!! S-So heavy!
I'm gonna get crushed!

J-Just hang in there a bit longer!
I'm sure someone is gonna come help us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That sounds like... Rin?! Len?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
What are you two...?
Wait, why are you carrying this giant prop...?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There we are...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Fortunately, neither of you seem to be hurt.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now, would you two mind explaining to me what happened here? Didn't I ask you both to start by moving the smaller props?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
W-We're sorry...
We really wanted to help you, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We thought we might be able to carry a big one as long as we took breaks. We were actually going to take one just now...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But we ended up dropping it. That caused the foundation to break and everything started falling on top of us...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I appreciate you wanted to help me so much...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I'd feel a million times worse than sad if something were to happen to either of you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Does that make sense?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah... Sorry for taking things too far.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
And breaking that big prop...
We're really sorry...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Again, I'm just glad you're both safe...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, let's carry this big one together! After that, we'll go over and apologize to everyone together.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Sorry, MEIKO...
We really thought we could do something for you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Don't say that.
You've already done plenty by helping move those smaller props for me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Also, nobody out there is good at everything!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know you might feel bad about not being able to do more sometimes, but all you have to do then is figure out what you can do!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Just like how Rui and the others helped Tsukasa with his audition in whatever ways they could♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, don't worry. I'm sure you'll find a way. With that in mind, let's do what we can♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We promise to figure out what we can do and help you as much as possible, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good! That's the spirit!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
If only there were a way to get Luka to share in your wonderful enthusiasm.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's undoubtedly taking a nap somewhere right now. I'll need to do everything I can to wake her up once we get back to the stage!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Haha...!
The day before the solo show
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Tomorrow's the day of their solo show...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, and I'm hoping that they're all able to get in a good night's rest...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: D-Do you think they're gonna be okay...? I-I'm starting to get really worried!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin, you're not the one that's gonna be performing.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But they might actually get to go pro if it goes well!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: True. This is sort of a once in a lifetime opportunity.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. I've gotta think there are a lot of bands out there that've never even been given this chance...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: This is their first, but I hope they try to take advantage of it like it's their last.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Th-They will...!
I mean, they've been practicing like there's no tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Y-Y-Y-Yeah!
They'll totally do just fine!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But you never know what's gonna happen during any show, right? What if they have an equipment malfunction?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: At the same time, Shiho works where they're gonna play, so I'm sure they'll figure out—

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Len, wait...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you poking me...? Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You didn't have to jinx them like that, Len...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: S-Sorry... But you really shouldn't be so worried if you actually believe in Ichika and the others.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I-I'm not worried... I'm totally fine.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really? You definitely don't seem fine.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, let's all just settle down.
Miku and Rin for one, but you too, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Me? But I feel fine...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? All those negative thoughts running through your head... You're actually really worried, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I, uhh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Len, you're also worried...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! Why didn't you just say you were?! You didn't have to spell out that nightmare scenario to us!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Shut up...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, you two, no fighting.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know this probably won't solve anything, but we just need to believe that they'll do well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Miku said so herself.
They've been practicing like there's no tomorrow, so I'm sure their hard work will be rewarded.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know so!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If anything, we just need to have faith in them and think, “They'll do just fine!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Because we've all watched them work and practice like their lives depend on it, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's right. They've all been working so hard...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, all that's left is to enjoy the show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They told us that we'll be able to watch from somewhere safe, so let's try to have as much fun as we can!

rows.Speaker: Miku, Rin & Len
rows.Line:
Yes.
Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: *Quiver*

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Rin? Are you still worried?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, I feel a lot better!
Actually, I feel really excited now♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You do? That was quick.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe. I know how Rin feels.
Also...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I feel like playing something now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah!
We should have a quick session since we're all here!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, we'll need to get our instruments.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Agreed! So, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (The girls really put on such an incredible show...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (With each passing song, their performance just kept getting better and filled the venue with so much energy.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I watched them practice their full set multiple times, but they couldn't have played better. Or with more power.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It was filled with so much exuberance that I found myself wanting to sing along.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Speaking of which, the fill Honami threw in during their sixth song was very cool.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think it went something like this...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, that didn't sound right...
Oh, I think it's the snare at the end!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! This is it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
MEIKO, what was that?!
It sounded really cool!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, Rin, Len, hello!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Didn't Honami play that during the solo show?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, she did. I was just thinking about the girls' show and remembered the fill she played. So, I decided to give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That show was so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I almost cried during the third song when Ichi played her guitar solo!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She lifted everyone up so high as she sang and really hammered it home with her guitar!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, she really nailed the string bends for that part!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I got goosebumps just listening to her play.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Without that, I feel you'd lose a lot of that rock 'n' roll sound.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh? When did you all get here?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, we just stopped by to see who was playing the drums in such a fun way.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We also heard you talking from the corridor.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I guess we kept on talking with the door open.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I see that now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
So, what brings you all here?
Were you hoping to play something together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, we did bring our instruments with us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha! You all came prepared.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, we're gonna have a session?!
Lemme go grab my synth!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, I'll get my stuff too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If possible, I'd like to play something the girls played during their show...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me too. It should be fun to play what they did while talking about what happened.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, why don't we start with their first song and play all of them? We can talk about what we liked about it and such!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sure, let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay. They mentioned that they'll be holding their debrief after things have settled down, so this may help for when they do.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm ready.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Already?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You definitely seem the most eager.
But we should wait for Rin and Len to return, or risk incurring their wrath.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We're back!
Give us one sec to set up♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay!
By the way, we decided to play every song from their set.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All of them?!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Really?! Awesome!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let us know when you're ready!
I'll count us in once you are!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I wonder what Emu's doing right now...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for letting me borrow that Miku costume, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're welcome♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Emu...
You eyes look redder than before.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...
I was really moved by your guys' show.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: The ending surprised me a little, but it also made me really happy!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks for coming up with that for us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Based on the way she smiled, she certainly seemed genuinely happy...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Does this mean Emu's really going to stay behind at Phoenix Wonderland and...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: MEIKO, are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's like something's been bothering you since our show ended.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Are you worried about Emu...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes...
I can't help but worry about her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is Emu really not going to join Tsukasa and the others...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Emu loves the Wonder Stage and Phoenix Wonderland very much since they're essentially mementos of her grandfather...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I have a feeling that she'll want to keep protecting them even if it means having to feel sad at times.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I understand what she's feeling right now. And I wanna support her decision since she's so important to us...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But... But...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin...
Heeey! You guuuys!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh! That voice...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Rin
rows.Line: Emu...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You guys...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You gotta hear this...!
I... I...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Emu, what did we say?! Don't run ahead without us!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you're all here...!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
What's going on?
Your eyes are all...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: ...together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We... We get to keep doing shows together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: D-Does this mean...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Geez, you're sobbing so much that we can't hear what you're trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Look who's talking, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I can't say that I blame any of you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, can you tell us what happened?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Of course. Emu's brothers just came by and...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, they told Emu to venture out into the world to see and experience as many new things as she can.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They did...?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That's great, Emu...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Cry*
Emuuu!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And I'm really sorry for making you worry so much, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, don't mind me♪
All's well that ends well, right?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm so glad...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Would you like to borrow my handkerchief, KAITO?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I think I will...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This is so wonderful, Rui!
I'm really glad you didn't give up until the end.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Actually, I don't think I accomplished anything. Emu had her mind made up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Her brothers are the ones who ultimately made this all possible.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they may've been the ones who carried her over the line. However...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rui, I believe you explaining exactly how you feel played a crucial role in making that moment happen!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You've experienced this a number of times before, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's proof of how one's most honest feelings have the ability to move people's hearts!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My feelings were entirely self-interested...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But if what you say is right, MEIKO, I guess it's good to be selfish sometimes...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Exactly!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(I've seen just how much Rui's had on his mind...
And how carefully he's always thought about what to do next.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We really couldn't have asked for a happier ending!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everyone, do you all have your drinks ready?!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Miku
rows.Line: Ready☆

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We're ready as well.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Us too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Okay, I believe we're all set.
The floor is yours, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Nene, Rui, Emu!
A job well done on the anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Next, Miku, all of you...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We know we caused you all a lot of concern, but we managed to get to our new starting line! Thank you very much for supporting us the entire way!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, here's to a successful anniversary show, and to new beginnings.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Rui & Emu
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line:
Cheeers!
Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ahh! This juice is so yummy and cool!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line: I kept the drinks cool until just now using my refrigeration module.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, right. You can store drinks and stuff for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
There's a clear reason for that.
I installed it so we can quickly rehydrate after practices.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see.
I thought this was just another passing fancy...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
A passing fancy...?
Honestly, Tsukasa, Nene, who do you take me for exactly?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I spend all this time coming up with gizmos and gadgets for the actors performing in our shows...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Tsukasa and Nene are bullying Rui!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh dear. Naughty children need to be punished by having an ice-cold glass of juice caress their necks♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Haha! Oh no☆
You two gotta run♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Actually, that might be nice if they're all this temperature.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Everyone's smiling and having so much fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: They really are!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure what was going to happen after they decided to become freelancers, and after Emu made her initial decision.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Hehe... So much fun...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh...? Oh, Luka...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. She must feel so relieved to see that they're all smiling now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: MEIKO, are you guys eating? These chocolates are super yummy!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Really? Then, I'd like to try one!
Also, would you mind saving one for Luka? I'm sure she'll want one after she wakes up later.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you all again for inviting us to join you for this after-party.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As always, you were all there for us when we really needed it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Not only that, you, MEIKO and the others inspired us to change the ending of the anniversary show through your own show.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I was so surprised when I saw your new ending! I couldn't believe how wonderfully happy it was♪

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We decided to go with that after discussing it as a troupe. We wanted it to reflect our current situation.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes, I see!
And I'm really glad you went with that ending!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If I recall, “They made shows together while pursuing their dreams forever after,” yes?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm gonna meet lots of new people, experience lots of new things, come back to Phoenix Wonderland and fill it with even more smiles!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I of course plan to learn as much as I can in order to become a star in the future!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I want to hone my skills so that I can become an actress who performs around the world.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I'm going to put on a show with my dear friends that connects people around the world through their smiles.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Those are all such wonderful dreams.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, they are!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe☆ But we can't let them hog all the glory♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We should also put on lots and lots of shows that can make lots and lots of people smile!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna figure out how to put on even better shows so we can help Tsukasa and the others when they think they need it!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, that would be wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'll sleep a lot and...
See lots of wonderful dreams... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, Luka.
We weren't talking about those kinds of dreams.

rows.Speaker: Emu & Nene
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
It's Rin.
She's singing again.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: When Mafuyu went to tell her mom how she really felt that time...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I heard that hearing Miku sing Kanade's song helped settle her down.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena also felt better after she heard me sing that time...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So, I wanna learn how to be a better singer... For them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (And she's been practicing her singing ever since...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No, that didn't sound right...
I can sing that part a lot better...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She seems very focused right now, so she shouldn't notice me as long as I stay at least this far away.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, MEIKO.
There you are.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Luka...?
Were you looking for me?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. I'm bored, so why don't we play cat's cradle or something together?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd rather not.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You never want to play.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Were you watching Rin just now?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I just came across her singing a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I see.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Why are you grinning like that...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. Good question.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
So, MEIKO.
Would you be mad if I went over to talk to her?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, but...
You shouldn't right now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why's that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Can't you tell...?
She's practicing, so you shouldn't interrupt her.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? You're showing quite a lot of interest despite just spotting her a second ago.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Can you not start pressing my buttons just because you're bored?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I don't know what you're talking about.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Fine...
I'll tell you a little about what Rin told me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, she's practicing to become a better singer for the others?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay, now I see why I shouldn't interrupt her.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I hoped you would've figured that out without me saying anything.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, MEIKO, the stance you're taking intrigues me.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You always talk about keeping your distance in order to make objective decisions, but you also seem to care quite a lot about how the people around you feel.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Being objective means not letting my personal values and ideas influence my decisions. It doesn't mean purging myself of my humanity.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. True.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Anyway, MEIKO, thank you.
I'm a little less bored now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
And don't worry.
In return, I promise not to bother Rin.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now, I think I'll go look for Miku or Len...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Suit yourself...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She seems to have figured out that part she was struggling with...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I think I'll keep watching for a bit longer.)
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Her singing's improved quite a lot...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Maybe meeting our other selves in that strange SEKAI had a greater effect on her than I realized.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for being such a strong source of support for the others.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All we can do is watch over them, but I can see that they're in good hands!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Based on what I've seen watching you all this time, it's obvious to me that they need you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't always have to put what you feel into words. They feel better just knowing that you're there for them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Just as how Rin and I play different roles here, that other me must also have a unique role in all of this.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (All she can do is watch over the others.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (In the sense that we both watch others from a distance, we sort of play similar roles.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (However, the big difference between her and us is that we can directly interact with the person whose feelings gave birth to this place at any time.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Still, I don't plan on doing that any time soon...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(She noticed me...
I was wondering why she stopped singing.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I don't want to interrupt her, so I should probably move further away and...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
MEIKO, wait.
You were listening to me practice just now, right...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Can you sing with me again like you did earlier?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Earlier...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Oh, I see...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This is how I'm singing it now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But I feel like I'm missing something...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't know if this is what you had in mind, but you could try doing something like this...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I like it...
Lemme try that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
...!
That was really good.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I couldn't figure that part out when I was working on it on my own...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How did you learn to sing like that, MEIKO...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I thought about this while singing just now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I thought about who I want to support.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Not just my feeling of wanting to support someone, but also who and with what words...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And about how I'd like those words to affect them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How those words will affect them...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You know what I'm talking about, right, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh...
I think that's how I felt when I sang for Ena...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Thanks, MEIKO...
I'll keep that in mind while I try.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You don't always have to put what you feel into words. They feel better just knowing that you're there for them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll sing with you...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm already involved now.
Also, I should probably try something new for a change...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Yeah, I want you to sing with me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're welcome.
Program Studio

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Welcome back to another episode of “Get on Those Hot Topics!”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Let's straight into it as we have a special guest with us here today! Please introduce yourself!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hello everyone! I'm MEIKO, the VIRTUAL SINGER!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Though I'm sure all of you already know, MEIKO will be performing in the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show, scheduled to be held in Shibuya!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Today, we hope to introduce our viewers to MEIKO, while also asking a variety of questions.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe, I look forward to it.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: With that goal in mind, we have gone out to the city and asked people about what comes to mind when they think of MEIKO. Let's have a look at the footage!

rows.Speaker: Passerby A
rows.Line:
What springs to mind when I think about MEIKO?
Hmm... I suppose an independent woman who rocks red!

rows.Speaker: Passerby B
rows.Line: Hmmm... I have this image of her being associated with alcohol.

rows.Speaker: Passerby C
rows.Line: True! Her outfits are always so attractive and she's really cool too. She's the kind of woman I look up to.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you for all of your responses, everyone! It makes me happy to hear that I'm someone to look up to.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: A lot of people mentioned your maturity and attractiveness, which truly are some of your charming points.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: There were also a lot of people who said that they associate you with alcohol as well.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Hehe. I suppose that's because some of the songs I sing include the subject in the lyrics.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: We have also received a message specifically for this program.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Oh, what does it say?>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: “Until a little while ago, I was frustrated and constantly crying about my lack of talent.”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: “But then I discovered MEIKO. Her voice had this strong determination and it really comforted me.”

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: “I realized that, in order to make your dream come true, you also need to work on improving your skills. So I'm going to do my best and keep my head held high.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Thank you so much for the wonderful message! I'm so happy to hear that I was a source of comfort for you.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Putting in consistent effort to make your dreams come true is not an easy feat and I'm sure there will be some tough obstacles along the way, but I hope you give it your all and have no regrets!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Thank you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Speaking of dreams, there's a special event that you will be holding during the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes! It's called the New Breeze & Reboot Festival! It's an exhibition that will be held right next to the concert venue.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <There will be paintings, photographs, sculptures and even wood prints. It'll be showcasing many works of art with us as their subjects.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: From up-and-coming artists to more seasoned creators who are making a comeback...

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: The news has been making the rounds since the initial announcement, hasn't it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Yes!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <The New Breeze & Reboot Festival will also have a cafe area filled with comics and novels available for everyone to enjoy.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <Delicious coffee, juice and finger foods will also be provided. Oh, alcoholic drinks are unfortunately not available, and don't you dare think about sneaking them in.>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like a recipe for a nice, relaxing reading session!

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: By the way, even those who do not have concert tickets are welcome to enter the exhibition.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <There will be so many wonderful works there that it will truly be a feast for the eyes. So I hope you can make it!>

rows.Speaker: Host
rows.Line: That's all for today, but we hope you look forward to the VIRTUAL SINGERS Show and...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <The New Breeze & Reboot Festival!>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Host
rows.Line:
<Hope you can make it!>
Thank you!
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, you guys! You can still keep going, right?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
What about you guys in the crowd?
Are you having a good time?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: How about our audience watching us live on stream and the remote screenings?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Having the best time!>
<Such a hyped medley!>
<This is the best!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Looks like everyone is having a great time!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that!
Now let's keep raising the energy from here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That reminds me, all of the songs you've been singing have had such a cool and mature energy to them, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That's true. You had us sing some of them with you, but you really did hit it out of the park each time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hahaha, thank you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, I didn't intentionally put more of those types of songs in my list. The songs I wanted to sing just ended up being those.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I suppose they matched the impressions people had of me on that program I was on recently.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, yeah! KAITO and I were invited to that same program too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It was quite interesting how they interviewed people on the street about their impressions of you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There were a lot of people who found you mature and attractive, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I do wear red most of the time, so I wonder if that encouraged that impression of me.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your red outfit is amazing. It stands out on stage and enhances your presence. I think it suits you the best.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, see? Everyone here agrees with me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, that's so lovely.
Thank you, Miku, everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I've been trying to be very conscious of a variety of things while singing today. So I hope you're ready for the songs coming your way!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: While we're on the topic, could you tell us what you were being conscious of when singing?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I want to know too♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Even the crowd too?
I guess I have to share now, don't I?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well today's concert is a little special in that all of us are singing songs together that we usually would alone together, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So I've been trying to show more of myself and how I sing more than usual, not only during my own songs but during others as well.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see... More of yourself, huh?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Especially since the creators that wrote my songs specifically chose me to sing them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I wanted to make sure to stand proud and sing them with confidence.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To not only be aware of those things, but to put them into practice perfectly too... That's incredible.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. I feel like that is one of the cool things about you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you. But you know compliments won't get you anywhere.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, looks like we're ready to move on to the next song!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. We've been talking about how cool I am, but I'd like you all to see the cute side to me too, right, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's get everyone blushing and giddy!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Blushing and giddy?
What kind of song are you planning to sing?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You'll just have to wait to find out♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright then...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Miku
rows.Line: Start the music!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If I'm going to do a complete revamp of this place, I guess I'll have to change the wallpaper...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, hello you two. Did you just finish practice?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, we sure did.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We were both on such a roll today that practice ended before we knew it♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Nice work. I'm sure you're both parched from singing. Anything to drink?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Iced cafe au lait for me, please.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'll have the same.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Got it. Coming right up.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you♪ Miku, let's sit over here!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By the way... What were you saying to the wall just before we came in, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, so you saw that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, I was thinking of revamping the cafe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since Kohane and the others are going into a new school year, I thought it would be good to also give this place a makeover.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oooh, I like that! So when are you gonna start the revamp?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hold your horses. I'm still thinking about it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Whaaat? Just do it! It'll be so fun.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
There are a lot of things to consider, you know?
Here you are. Two iced cafe au laits.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: When you say “revamp,” what exactly did you have in mind?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, for starters...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The current wallpaper compliments the plants, which gives off a warm vibe, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yeah, go on...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I was thinking... Maybe, making it completely white?
That way it can have a classier look whilst also keeping its warmth.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oooh! I bet that would look really nice!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But if you change the wallpaper, then the shelves at the back need to match too, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
That's right. The lights will need to change as well.
So if I'm going to revamp, might as well do everything all at once...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh no. This sounds like a lot more work than I thought.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I told you. Not only will doing the work on this place be tough, but I'll also need to close it until the revamp is complete.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't have that! Where will I get my coffee fix and fill my social cup if this place is closed for renovation?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Again, that's what I meant by a lot of things to consider.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: An's dad also closed his cafe for the time being...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If I close this place too, then Kohane and the others won't have a place to relax.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's true. We should try to avoid that.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're already working hard enough at practice, so I want to make sure they have somewhere to rest.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I feel the same.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It would've been nice to change it up, but I think I'll let it go for now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's a shame, but it's probably for the best.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, how about this! What if you made some minor changes like changing the plants or the artwork you have up right now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I bet it'll be fun to do a “spot the difference” game afterward!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “Spot the difference?”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you, Luka.
I think I'll go with your proposal and make some subtle changes.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really?! Then I'd like one serving of dessert for every difference I spot♪ Do we have a deal?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What kind of deal is that?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You just want to do this for your benefit, don't you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oops. You got me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Goodness. I can't with you.
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Alright, let's come up with a new menu that screams new change and new beginnings!

rows.Speaker: Len & Rin
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, you all seem to be really excited about this.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Why wouldn't we? Thinking up a new menu is so fun!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Not to mention that we get to be the taste testers too!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Still, I was still surprised when you brought the subject up. I didn't expect you to want to revamp the cafe.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But canceling that idea is what led you to go with a new menu instead, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, exactly. So I'm counting on the three of you today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Leave it to us!
I actually already have a few ideas for this new menu of yours.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Yes!
Picture an item called, “Favorites for Lunch.”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ooh! Sounds amazing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: And it sure will be! It's a dish that will have all of the customers' favorites on it.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: For example, pancakes for Akito.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I see, that sounds interesting.
However...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: An likes rum raisin ice cream, right? So if she orders that, then she'd end up with ice cream for a meal.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: True. Toya likes cookies and I don't know if that's substantial for lunch...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You have a point. Kohane's favorite food is peach buns and sesame balls. I think those would be okay as a lunch dish, but...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then why don't we make their favorites come as an extra with their overall meal?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm sure they'd like it, but then it wouldn't feel like a new menu, would it?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oof. You're right...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh! In that case, instead of having it as an extra, how about we just get them to pick their main dish for their meal?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, that sounds amazing!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Main dish for their meal...
So like steak or ginger fried pork?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I like that.
I'd want them to eat well so they can get some energy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Then curry and stew would be pretty good, no? By putting in meat and different kinds of vegetables, it'll be a good balance of nutrients!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good thinking! It's important to get your nutrients and vitamins in to maintain your body.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Seems like having a menu with a good amount of vegetables is the way to go. Maybe I'll add a salad in there too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But Akito hates carrots, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: And An can't eat tomatoes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's...not good, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It seems like those two are not ones to leave food on their plates at home... So I'll incorporate those into certain dishes.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Nice! Looks like we're starting to really make progress! Just slap on a name and it'll sound like a new menu in no time.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I'm starting to think that if you just get to choose your main dish, it doesn't make it all that more special than a regular set meal.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You think so? I feel like it'd be fun to try out all sorts of combinations!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Which brings me to my next point! I'd like to name the steak dish, “Big Bang Steak.”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, I like that. Using the name to figure out the type of dish is always fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If that's on the table, then I have some ideas!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Um, so for the veggie-filled curry...
Tons of... Packed with...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I got it! How does, “Garden Goodness Curry” sound?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hahaha, what kind of name is that? Did you want some curry and rice with your garden of vegetables?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, it's not gonna be like that!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (It's always fun thinking of a new menu with everyone.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Especially coming up with combinations for dishes and imagining the expressions of those who will eventually have them...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since you two already suggested the Big Bang Steak and the Garden Goodness Curry, I think we should try them out.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Really?! Yay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hey MEIKO, if you have some extra time to spare, I think a stew would make a great addition.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
How does “Dreamy☆Creamy Stew”?
 It would also have a nice, gentle flavor that just rejuvenates you from the inside.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is what you say, but you're just stating your order, aren't you?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I would never! I've never been more serious about suggesting anything than I ever have in my life.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I wonder about that...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
Besides, we're still in the testing phase anyway.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's try out some stuff and make a menu that'll put a smile on VBS' faces!

rows.Speaker: Rin, Len & KAITO
rows.Line: Yeah!
Between Worlds

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's peaceful here, as usual.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I suppose I'll spend another day leisurely watching over the SEKAI while I sing.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh? This is...a fragment of a feeling.
*Sniffle*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm...? I think I just heard...
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Someone's crying...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Their voice...
Is it coming from this fragment...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, I can't leave it be just because it's only a fragment!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let me get in touch with your feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This is...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (The place has a classy, quiet feel to it... But something about it makes my heart feel tight...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Is this...sadness? No, maybe frustration...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There's something on the floor.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This sheet of paper...was somebody writing?
It's been crumpled up into a ball, though...

rows.Speaker: Somebody's Writing
rows.Line:
• Protagonist
A high school girl with average looks and brains.
Has a dream, but her family and teachers disapprove.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Looks like that's all that's written.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm concerned about those crying sounds I heard before I touched the fragment... I think I'll take a look around.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh... There's another sheet of paper on the floor.
This one hasn't been crumpled up.

rows.Speaker: Somebody's Writing
rows.Line:
• The person she looks up to
The type of mature person the protagonist wishes to become.

rows.Speaker: Somebody's Writing
rows.Line: Extends a hand to the protagonist with a soft, warm smile, charming to all regardless of their age or gender.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... And the other sheet I picked up had the “protagonist”. Seems like these are background notes on the characters of a story.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Does that mean the owner of these feelings is writing a story of some kind?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
...!
Is someone there?
Yes. I'm here...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (A girl?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Um...
Are you the owner of the feelings behind this fragment SEKAI?

SEKAI...?
I don't know what you're talking about, but the answer is no.
I'm “a high school girl with average looks and brains”...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: I'm the “protagonist” who's yet to become anybody at all, and hasn't even been given a name.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: An average high schooler... The protagonist...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's what was written on this sheet of paper...! It was about you?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: You were kind enough to pick up that crumpled sheet of paper. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
No, don't thank me.
Actually, I apologize. I shouldn't have read it without permission.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line:
Don't worry about that.
It's just a piece of garbage now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But this is what brought you to life, isn't it?
Please, you shouldn't talk about it like that...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line:
...
You're so nice...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line:
But of course I'd be tossed aside before long.
It was the same for all the other protagonists.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The owner of these feelings is writing a story, right? If so, surely they'd treat the protagonist with great care...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: I get the sense that she hates herself, and hates the protagonists she creates.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hate...? Why would that be?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: Well...
*Sniffle* *Sob*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (This sound of someone crying... It's the same as what I heard before I entered this SEKAI.)

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: She's...crying. Again.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, the person crying is this SEKAI's...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
...!
What's wrong? Are you alright...?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're crying too...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: Oh...this?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: It's fine. Half of me is made up of her, so I guess this just happens.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Half of you is...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: I get the sense that she hates herself, and hates the protagonists she creates.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (This protagonist... Did the owner of these feelings use herself as a base when making her?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I'm sure this protagonist was entrusted with all sorts of feelings and wishes when she was created...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But the owner of those feelings hates herself, so she can't bring herself to like someone who's so similar...?)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (If that's true, it's...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I don't think I can let things go on like this...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (Isn't there something I can do?)

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: I'm the “protagonist” who's yet to become anybody at all, and hasn't even been given a name.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line:
Of course I'd be tossed aside before long.
It was the same for all the other protagonists.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: I get the sense that she hates herself, and hates the protagonists she creates.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (If she continues hating herself...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (And even rejecting the protagonists who serve as other versions of herself...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (She may end up casting away her own feelings along with these characters.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I'm only supposed to be watching over her, but I just can't leave things like this.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Seems like you've calmed down now.
Are you alright?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: I'm fine... She was the one crying in the first place, not me.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hey, if you don't mind, I'd like to know more about you and the owner of these feelings.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: I can tell you, but there's nothing to say about me. It's all in those notes you picked up and...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: Oh, that's right... I think I've seen one other sheet that had slightly more detailed notes.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Really?! Then let's go find it!

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: But what good will it do you to learn about me...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, that's easy.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I want to read your story, you know.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The story may not be written yet, but if I look at the notes, I'm sure—

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: Why...?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: I'm an average high schooler with nothing special about me in the slightest, and I don't even have a name yet...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That may be what your background says, but in truth, you aren't average at all.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No matter how many people there are in the world, or how many stories...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The protagonist of your story is you and only you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now then! Let's look for that sheet with the notes about you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let's see, this one is...
This background seems like it's for a fantasy character, so it probably isn't yours.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anything on your end?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: Nothing...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: I'm sure that sheet got thrown away too, so we're never going to...
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh... I hear her again...

rows.Speaker: Owner of the Feelings
rows.Line: This is my dream... Why won't they understand...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She's...

rows.Speaker: Owner of the Feelings
rows.Line:
No... No...
I don't want to quit yet.

rows.Speaker: Owner of the Feelings
rows.Line:
Let me keep trying just a little longer...
If you do, I know... I just know...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
