Did you hear that?
The owner of these feelings wants to keep trying...!

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line:
All talk, I'm sure.
It doesn't mean what you think it does.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: After all, lately she's only been able to write stories where the protagonist gets saved by guidance from the person she looks up to.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, that was on one of the sheets I picked up. It said that person would extend a hand to the protagonist.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Isn't that fine, though?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She could create a compelling story even just around the identity of the person guiding her. Are they a teacher, a senior at school, or someone she's never even met before?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line:
Why...?
Why are you so accepting of her?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: Oh, I get it... She made you that way, didn't she?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
You never asked, so it hadn't crossed my mind to tell you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I actually came here from somewhere else.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: You mean, that's the background you were created with...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha...
You can think of it that way if you prefer...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But anyway, this place is a SEKAI created from a fragment of a feeling that belongs to the person who made you.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: A SEKAI...? A fragment of a feeling...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I heard someone crying in this SEKAI and wanted to know what was wrong, so I came to see what was going on.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: My friends and I do things like this. We make the effort to understand people's feelings and watch where they go.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: Watch where they go...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why I won't reject someone for having an attitude that might be seen as passive, like wanting a guide to save them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think there are plenty of people out there in a position where they can't do anything on their own.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: B-But...!

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: But that's just... It's like you're depending on someone else, and...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's not fair?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I may have just learned something else about you and her.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: What do you mean, you learned something...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You said the owner of these feelings hates herself and the protagonists she creates, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think that contempt may be directed more specifically at the vulnerability she feels in wanting to cling to someone.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: When I arrived here, I felt sadness and frustration.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sure that sadness is about having no one who understands her dream.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
As for the frustration...
Part of it is probably about her inability to produce results, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think it's mostly about how weak she feels for trying to cling to someone else.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: Then, does she...really want to keep trying...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Like I said, I don't think getting guidance from someone is a bad thing at all.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
But if that feels unfair...
Your only choice is to stand back up on your own.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I believe the person who created you understands that, at least.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Actually, maybe you could all just become that person to look up to.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line:
Wait, m-me...?
But, I don't even have a name yet...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: Would I be able to do that...?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: If I decide I want to...will I be able to...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh...
Seems like it's about time for us to say goodbye.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'll still be watching right by your side.
Give the owner of these feelings my regards!

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: U-Um...! Wait...!

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: Your name...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: You have one, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes.
Maybe I shouldn't talk it up so much, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I love my name. I'm very proud of it.
It's loved and treasured by so many people.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: That's so nice...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: I wonder if, one day...I'll get such a wonderful name myself.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
The owner of these feelings will give you a name that fits perfectly.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Along with a truly amazing story, of course.

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: She's gone...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: Oh yeah, I was looking for the sheet that has more notes about me...

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line: What kind of person did she want me to become...?

rows.Speaker: Unnamed Girl
rows.Line:
I'll keep looking.
I need to find it for myself.
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Sounds good. I think I'll go with the drums for today's practice with everyone.
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? Someone's running this way...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
There you are!
This might be a little sudden, MEIKO, but is there anything you'd like to do?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh? Anything I'd like to do?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hold on, are you preparing for my anniversary?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! H-How did you know?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyone who can read between the lines would know from the way you asked.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: B-But, but...! It's still a month away! I didn't think she would see through me!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I guess you were a little too direct.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Noooo...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... Should I have pretended I didn't notice anything?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's okay, please don't mind her. I mean, that was a little...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, Saki's just being a klutz.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: A k-klutz?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm just telling the truth.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ack!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
Honaaa. My heart is broken in pieces...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There, there. You were just a little too enthusiastic about celebrating.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. I will say, I'm touched that you want to start preparing a month early.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We'll need to prepare in between practices, so we thought we should at least decide what we're doing as soon as possible.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
So, to rewind the conversation...
Is there anything you want to do?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... Is there anything...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Sorry.
I don't really have anything that I definitely want to do...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Anything is okay, MEIKO! A takoyaki party or even hot pot, you name it! There's so many fun things we can do!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Right...
Doing something with everyone does sound fun.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: MEIKO, is there really nothing you want to do?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Or could it be that it'd be hard for us to make it happen...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's not it at all. I really can't think of anything in particular...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If I had to say something, it would be a performance... But we already do that together basically every day.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As far as something special or befitting of my anniversary, nothing comes to mind.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm sorry I can't give you a proper answer.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Now that I think about it... Maybe the reason why nothing comes to mind is because I'm content with how things are now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How things are now...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yeah. Like I mentioned before, we basically perform together every day, don't we?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I have so much fun that I don't need anything else.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since I'm already satisfied with just that, I think it's hard for me to come up with other ideas.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That's why I'll be more than happy If I can just do something fun with all of you like Saki suggested before.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I didn't realize you enjoyed performing with us that much.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I do. I mean, just a moment ago, I was figuring out which instrument to go with for today's practice.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So if I can just do something with all of you...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh, I've got it!
I can just do that together with you girls!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Do what?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Did you come up with something?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I did!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, what I want to do is...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Prepare my anniversary party with all of you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I se—Whaaaaaaat?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're going to prepare for your own anniversary?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well, everyone would usually tell me that I don't need to do anything and I should just look forward to it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I thought it might actually be interesting to plan and execute my own anniversary celebration!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. That really sounds like you, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, I hope you'll all lend me a hand!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course. If that's what you want, then we'll help out however we can.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mhm♪ The MEIKO in our world is also going to hold a massive event, so we need to make sure our party tops that!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I get how you feel, but isn't that a pretty big goal to set?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Who cares♪ It's all about the intention behind it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, what sort of event is the me in your world doing?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would you like to see the event's website? The details have been trickling in recently.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Really? Let's see it.
VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hey, everyone!
Thank you for coming to my anniversary event!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everyone here and everyone watching the stream, we're going to make today the best day ever!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Are you all ready?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I'm ready whenever!>
<You're the best, MEIKO! I love you!>
<Let's hype it up!>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We're good to go too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Start whenever you're ready.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Got it!
Alright then...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let the MEIKO Special Anniversary Event...
Begin!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Did you all enjoy that show segment?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Everyone was waving their glow sticks to the beat!
It was so much fun singing!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We harmonized perfectly too.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! We did practice it just for today, so I'm glad we were able to pull it off!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too! But we're still far from finished.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: There's still plenty of performances left, so we hope you look forward to them!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, aside from shows, we also have other exciting segments planned for today.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: After all, we're not here today for a “show”, but rather an “event”!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
This is like our usual shows so far...
What other segments are we doing?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We'll be playing a little game.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: A game?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Yes! And it's called—
The silent singing game!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We usually express feelings through our songs, but this gesture game will require us to see how well can we express things without our singing or any sort of sound!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! We can't sing or make any sounds?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That seems really difficult. How do we play?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As the name of the game suggests, we have to be completely silent and use our facial expressions and gestures to communicate our allocated song.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, I've only included songs we've performed up until now. That should be a big hint.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: The rules are simple, but it sounds like it'd be hard when you're actually doing it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I would like to see how much I'm able to get across.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright everyone, let's all form a line!
The person at the front will go first and the others will guess!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The allocated song will display on the screen behind you, so don't think about taking a peek, okay?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everyone in the audience, feel free to join in!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm starting to get nervous. I wonder if I can do this.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Don't worry. Let's all just have fun.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: C'mon MEIKO, let's start already!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, alright. Okay, so the order will be...
Len, Rin, Luka, Miku, KAITO and then me!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Now, let the silent singing game...
Begin!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Okay, so my allocated song is... Ack!
That's first up?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, that move...!
Right, you can easily recognize the song if it has a dance!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Mhm! But it's such a cute dance routine that I want to keep watching.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Hehe. Len seems to be begging with his eyes for us to hurry up and guess it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for hyping up the event with us, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We performed, played games and even had some chatting segments too! This event program was jam-packed.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes. All that's left is for us to sing the finale. But before that, we have some messages for MEIKO.
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
MEIKO! Happy anniversary!
We ended up doing those segments after you suggested we try something new, and they were really fun!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure that's because you really thought about what games would make it fun for everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're a wonderful person, and you always think about how to make everyone smile! I can't wait to make more memories with you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, MEIKO! This event was so much fun! We got to sing songs and even play games!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: If you find any other fun games, let me know so we can play together! I'll let you know if I find anything interesting too!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh! If you're going to play some games, then I definitely wanna join too! I especially enjoyed the gesture game!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehehe. I like getting to hang out and play with you, MEIKO. So let's play again sometime! Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, MEIKO. I'm sure being the main host for your own celebration was tough...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But, of course, you pulled it off so seamlessly. Let's give one last burst of energy until the end.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It feels like we just started the event moments ago, and now we're going into the finale... I guess the more fun you're having, the faster time flies by.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You've blessed us with such a wonderful time, and I hope that you have an even more amazing year! Happy anniversary!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for the wonderful messages, everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I wanted to have a fun time with everyone who came to celebrate, which is why I decided to do the gesture game.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There were a lot of laughs, surprises and even head scratching, so I had lots of fun too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm going to keep singing many more songs, but I'll also be thinking about other ways to keep making wonderful memories.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Just one more thing I hope you'll all help me out with.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Of course we will, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Please let us know anytime there's something you want to do.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Even if it's something a little difficult, I'm sure we can make it happen if we work together.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you! And I think so too.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you so much for coming to celebrate with me, everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's keep trying new things and make lots of fun memories together!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright!
Here's our final song!
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The Showa Commemorative Museum that Tsukasa and the others went to sounded like so much fun!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I love how they took an old building from back then and turned it into a museum. It's such a wonderful idea...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I know, right☆
It's too bad that we couldn't go with them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I'm really glad that they brought back all those souvenirs and stuff for us♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Me too!
Especially that giant diorama of a city from back then! It's so nice of them to want us to get a feel for the time period.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm having a lot of fun with the tin toy Rui brought back! Check it out! When you wind it up, it starts whirring and moving around.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I really liked that old-timey soda☆ It was so sweet and fizzy, it felt like there was a party going on in my mouth♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I really love this scarf♪
I've been able to sleep even better when I use it as a pillow...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Luka, no!
All you've been doing is sleeping since you got that scarf!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha... We did receive quite a lot from them.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I'm sure Tsukasa and the others are working very hard to make the most of what they learned at the museum.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I agree.
Performing somewhere new and different is never easy, but I'm hoping that they succeed.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hmm... Isn't there anything we can do for them? I wanna help them if possible!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too! Me too! Can't we do something?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, I know. We can help them learn more about what things were like back in the Showa period by putting on a show set in that era!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
So, a Showa show?!
That sounds super fun☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But we still don't really know what life was like back then...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: True. We may not have enough information to put on such a show...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. I've got that covered.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you already have an idea for us, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I do!
Included in the many gifts Tsukasa and the others brought back was this museum pamphlet.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It includes all these articles describing what life was like back then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So, why don't we use these to put a show together?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow...! This could actually work☆

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: In that case, we should also prepare some props and costumes that are reminiscent of the time period.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, great idea!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe♪ I wanna wear a cute one-piece dress like the one Emu had on☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
I wanna try on a kimono!
I saw some pictures of people wearing hats with them!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Also, we can use the diorama as a reference for our set. We should be able to achieve a nice atmosphere if we accurately recreate some of these buildings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I agree! We can maybe even use some of the souvenirs the others brought back as props. That just leaves...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: What about these vehicles in the diorama...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I thought they were regular cars at first, but they look a little different. Do any of you know what they are?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, I think they called those...three-wheel trucks.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Three-wheel trucks...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, automobiles with only three wheels. Rui showed me a few pictures. They were apparently very common back in that era.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's build one!!!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: B-Build one...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, let's build ourselves a three-wheel truck!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm seeing quite a few in this diorama. Does that mean they were a common sight back then?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: There's even one in the manga printed in this pamphlet! Here, look...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Hey, she's right!
It says, “These were a common mode of transportation during the Showa period”☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: See what I mean? It's in this pamphlet, so that means we have to have one in our show to make it feel real.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: W-Wait...! We're really going to make one of these...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Obviously!
We're going to blow everyone away with our show, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Cool! SEKAI's gonna be so much more fun with one of these around☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We could all take it for a spin around SEKAI!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I wanna do that♪
I'll do whatever you need to help make it☆

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe♪ That's what I like to hear!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Th-This could get really out of hand...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Zzz... Zzz...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Luka, wake up!
You're going to help too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Mhm... MEIKO, not so rough...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's make ourselves a three-wheel truck!!

rows.Speaker: Len, Miku & Rin
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yeah☆
Wonderland SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Okay, everyone appears to be asleep...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I've been waiting for this moment!
Now... It's time to head over♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Heh heh heh...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's finally complete! The SEKAI three-wheel truck!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. It's such a cute shape♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
And this paint job!
It's so colorful, I can't help but get excited♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know we just finished putting it together and agreed to wait until tomorrow to take it for a spin, but...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I just can't wait! I want to practice driving it now! I mean, the props in the bed need to be moved over to the stage anyway.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Let's see...
First, I need to start the engines, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
(What did KAITO do after we finished...?
I want to say he put the key in here and turned it...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? That doesn't seem to be it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hmm... It seems this lever isn't involved, but what about this button...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Whoa! It's for the wipers!
What if I pressed the button next to it? Will that turn them off...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Eep! It's for the lights!
Wait, which button did what again?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: O-Okay, it's finally all back to the way it was...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But I still don't know how to start the engine... Nothing I pulled or pressed seemed to work.)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hm? Come to think of it, I haven't tried using this pedal by my foot yet...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I vaguely recall KAITO putting his foot down it when he started the engine...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'll press down while turning the key! Here goes nothing!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh... It started...!
Now I can finally drive it!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Let's go!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wooooow!
This feels incredible!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: All the scenery flying by looks so beautiful...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (The flying train and big Ferris wheel make SEKAI feel fun and lively as usual...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (But it's like I get to see them in a brand new light as I drive around!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Phew.
Now, where should I go next...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I still need to take the props in the bed over to the stage.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, I'll head over there and...
What's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line:
Mhm...
All that loud vrooming made me wake up...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh no... Did I disturb you?
I'm so sorry.

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: No, that's okay. But... What is this thing?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
This is called a three-wheel truck!
It goes very fast! So fast that you get to be like the wind!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Like the wind...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes! You can get from the Ferris wheel to the stage in no time at all!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line:
Wow...! That sounds really fun!
I wanna ride it too!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hop on in!
I was actually just thinking it would be nice to have someone in the passenger seat...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As my way of apologizing for waking you, I'll take you for a little nighttime drive around SEKAI♪

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Yay! I get to go for a drive!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Alright, are you ready?

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line: Yeah! My seatbelt's all set!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Then, let's go...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's time for some fast and furious driving!!!!!

rows.Speaker: Bunny Plushie
rows.Line:
Whoooooa!
We're really like the wiiiiiiiiind!!!
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Okay, so far so good...
For the last point, focus on the tip of your brush and gently lean it forward.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
...!
I-It worked...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Whoa! That's amazing, Miku-P!
It looks so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That last part was so intense. I could feel your concentration from over here, Miku...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes, I even held my breath there for a second...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It just means she was that focused.
So, Miku, how do you feel about this one?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I think it's my best work yet.
Thank you for giving me those tips, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Haha. Hearing you say that makes it all worth it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: MEIKO! Me next! I want you to teach me! I've been practicing a bunch, but I still can't get it right...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Alright, sit here then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I think it'll turn out better if you improve your posture, Rin. Open up about a fist between you and the desk...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You really are amazing, MEIKO...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, it's like you've already become our second teacher.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She is the best calligrapher out of all of us.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, you think so?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. Even though you struggled just as much when we started working on our New Year's resolutions...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Did you practice in secret or something?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, you could say that...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for giving me another lesson today, Shiho. I think I have a better idea of what to do now!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I'm glad to hear that.
How are the others doing...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
They've been improving at a steady rate.
We also have you to thank for that, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, I didn't do anything special...
You're all improving because you're putting in the effort.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me. I should give this to you before I forget.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Please feel free to use it if you like.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, a notebook...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yes, it contains a list of tips and tricks that I thought would help. Maybe you and the others can use it for reference.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Wow, this is incredible...!
It talks about maintaining a good posture, how to hold your brush... And it's all so beautifully written.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Everything in this notebook... It must've taken you a very long time to write it all down.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It wasn't any trouble. It just doesn't feel right to me to not give the commitments I've made the effort they deserve.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Also, seeing you and the others work so hard to improve made me want to give the best advice I could.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see. Then, we promise to cherish this gift.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
